We numerically demonstrate that supercooled liquids can exhibit persistent non-Maxwellian velocity distributions with deviations connected to their exceptionally slow super-Arrhenius relaxation. Our work is motivated by a general result establishing that long lived metastable states may exhibit finite width distributions of intensive variables. A distribution of temperatures implies non-Maxwellian velocity statistics. We test this prediction by introducing stochastic thermostats that generate stationary states while, unlike conventional thermostats, not imposing Maxwellian velocity distributions. Simulations with these thermostats yield long lived states that have, by comparison to Maxwellian velocity distributions, an excess kurtosis $0<κ\lesssim0.3$. Crystallization is strongly impeded with increasing $κ$. In a minimal description, temperature fluctuations are characterized by a dimensionless width $\overline{A}$ with $κ\simeq3\overline{A}^{2}$. The nearly constant $\overline{A}$ (of an average value $0.08$ and standard deviation $0.03$) found in viscosity data collapse across $45$ glass formers and in specific heat signatures is consistent with kurtosis found in our simulations. Long time non-Maxwellian velocity statistics may thus link slow relaxation, transport, and thermodynamic measurements. Independent of the tested theory, the stochastic thermostats that we introduce offer a molecular dynamics route to non-Maxwellian velocity statistics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。关键词：numerically demonstrate（数值演示）、simulations（模拟）、stochastic thermostats（随机热浴）、molecular dynamics（分子动力学）。；研究对象：过冷液体（supercooled liquids）中的速度统计分布，以及其与超阿伦尼乌斯粘度（super-Arrhenius viscosity）和玻璃化转变的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 过冷液体可以表现出持久的非麦克斯韦速度分布，其超额峰度κ（0<κ≲0.3）与异常缓慢的超阿伦尼乌斯弛豫相关；这种非麦克斯韦统计可能将慢弛豫、输运和热力学测量联系起来。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：过冷液体可以表现出持久的非麦克斯韦速度分布，其超额峰度κ（0<κ≲0.3）与异常缓慢的超阿伦尼乌斯弛豫相关；这种非麦克斯韦统计可能将慢弛豫、输运和热力学测量联系起来。；创新点：提出并验证了过冷液体中温度涨落（由无量纲宽度$\overline{A}$表征）可导致非麦克斯韦速度统计，并首次将这种统计偏差与超阿伦尼乌斯粘度的实验数据坍塌定量关联；同时引入了一种不预设麦克斯韦分布的新型随机热浴方法，为分子动力学模拟提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 引入一种新型随机热浴（stochastic thermostats），该热浴能生成稳态但不强制速度分布为麦克斯韦分布；通过分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics simulations）研究该热浴下过冷液体的速度统计；同时利用45种玻璃形成体的粘度数据坍塌和比热特征进行对比分析。

papers.title: Untangling 3D atomic reconstruction in twisted bilayer 2D crystals via dark field transmission electron microscopy
papers.abstract: Reconstruction of the atomic crystal structure in twisted 2D materials has been demonstrated to be responsible for multiple exciting phenomena in van der Waals heterostructures, from the appearance of flat bands in twisted bilayer graphene to Wigner crystallization in transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs). However, there are still no experimental methods for accessing the 3D atomic distributions nor models that describe the exact atomic shifts in such reconstructed structures, which significantly impedes the development of the field. Dark field (DF) transmission electron microscopy (TEM) has been conventionally employed to visualize the local in-plane atomic displacements. Here we expand this method to obtain a full description of the reconstructed atomic systems and demonstrate the quantitative relations between the local stacking and the intensity in the DF image. We show how local 3D atomic displacements and the interlayer distance can be extracted from a DF image.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及“dark field transmission electron microscopy (DF-TEM)”作为实验方法，并强调“expand this method”和“demonstrate the quantitative relations”。；研究对象：扭曲双层二维材料（twisted bilayer 2D crystals）中的三维原子重构（3D atomic reconstruction），具体涉及扭曲双层石墨烯和过渡金属硫族化合物（TMDs）中的原子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了暗场透射电镜（DF-TEM）图像强度与局部堆叠构型之间的定量关系，从而能够从单张DF图像中提取局域三维原子位移和层间距。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了暗场透射电镜（DF-TEM）图像强度与局部堆叠构型之间的定量关系，从而能够从单张DF图像中提取局域三维原子位移和层间距。；创新点：首次提出一种实验方法，能够直接获取扭曲双层二维材料中重构结构的三维原子分布，并定量提取层间距离和原子位移，填补了该领域缺乏三维原子分布实验手段的空白。
papers.method_zh: 暗场透射电子显微术（DF-TEM）。摘要中未提及计算或理论建模细节，仅说明该方法被扩展用于获取完整的三维原子重构描述。

papers.title: What enables GaOx as hole transport layer for a 16 percent 1.0 eV CuInSe2 Bottom Cells with VOC above 550 mV?
papers.abstract: Among the highly efficient photovoltaic technologies, that do not rely on epitaxy, only chalcopyrites have a bandgap tunable down to 1.00 eV, the ideal for tandem applications. This is obtained with a pure CuInSe2 absorber without Ga. GaOx has been shown to be an efficient hole transport layer that prevents recombination at the metallic back contact. On the other hand, GaOx has proven detrimental, when it forms on In containing transparent back contacts in bifacial solar cells. Here, we investigate the conditions that make the GaOx layer conductive. We employ a GaOx hole transport layer that is formed through ion exchange during co-evaporation of the low band gap absorber layer. We find that no additional Cu is needed, and that Na is not necessary for a conductive GaOx. Nor did we find a systematic influence of oxygen flow during the sputtering process of the oxide layer. The GaOx layer is partly crystalline. The optimized passivating hole transport layer enables a CuInSe2 bottom solar cell, without any addition of Ag or heavy alkalis, with an active area efficiency above 16% and a record-certified open-circuit voltage VOC of 552meV
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的实验过程（共蒸发、溅射）和器件性能测试（效率、开路电压）。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料、体系或物理现象是：GaOx（氧化镓）作为空穴传输层在低带隙（1.0 eV）CuInSe2（铜铟硒）太阳能电池中的应用，以及如何使该GaOx层具备导电性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过离子交换形成的部分结晶的GaOx层，无需额外添加Cu或Na，也无需特定氧气流量，即可作为有效的空穴传输层，使CuInSe2底电池实现超过16%的效率和552 mV的认证开路电压。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过离子交换形成的部分结晶的GaOx层，无需额外添加Cu或Na，也无需特定氧气流量，即可作为有效的空穴传输层，使CuInSe2底电池实现超过16%的效率和552 mV的认证开路电压。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于：系统研究了使GaOx层具备导电性的关键条件（否定了Cu、Na和氧气流量的必要性），并展示了该优化后的GaOx层在无Ag或重碱金属添加的情况下，实现了高性能的CuInSe2底电池。
papers.method_zh: 具体实验手段包括：共蒸发法沉积低带隙CuInSe2吸收层（在此过程中通过离子交换形成GaOx空穴传输层），溅射法沉积氧化物层，并对GaOx层的结晶性、导电性以及器件性能（效率、开路电压）进行表征和优化。

papers.title: Drift-diffusion interplay in active Brownian particles under orienting field
papers.abstract: Magnetic active particles offer a versatile route to externally controlled microscale transport by combining self-propulsion with field-tunable orientation, as realized in both synthetic and living magnetic microswimmers. Here, we develop a theoretical framework for three-dimensional active Brownian motion in a uniform magnetic field, incorporating coupled translational and rotational dynamics and providing analytical approximations for low-order displacement moments. At long times, the system dynamics reduces to a combination of enhanced diffusion and permanent drift absent in regular active Brownian particles. The field acts as an external controller, channeling activity toward one of these two types of motion. At intermediate time scales, the interplay between rotational noise, self-propulsion, and magnetic alignment results in pronounced non-Gaussian displacement statistics. First-passage properties exhibit strong field sensitivity, highlighting the potential of magnetic guidance to optimize search processes and targeted delivery in active matter systems. Theoretical predictions are validated by numerical simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟验证）。判断依据：关键词“theoretical framework”“analytical approximations”“numerical simulations”。；研究对象：在均匀磁场中运动的活性布朗粒子（active Brownian particles），具体为磁性活性粒子（magnetic active particles）的三维运动，涉及自推进与场可调取向的耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在长时间尺度下，系统动力学简化为增强扩散与永久漂移的组合，而普通活性布朗粒子中不存在永久漂移；磁场可作为外部控制器，将活性导向这两种运动之一。在中间时间尺度，旋转噪声、自推进与磁对准的相互作用导致显著的非高斯位移统计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在长时间尺度下，系统动力学简化为增强扩散与永久漂移的组合，而普通活性布朗粒子中不存在永久漂移；磁场可作为外部控制器，将活性导向这两种运动之一。在中间时间尺度，旋转噪声、自推进与磁对准的相互作用导致显著的非高斯位移统计。；创新点：揭示了磁场作用下活性布朗粒子中漂移-扩散的竞争与调控机制，特别是发现了普通活性布朗粒子中不存在的永久漂移，并展示了磁场对首次通过性质的强敏感性，为优化搜索过程和靶向输运提供了理论依据。
papers.method_zh: 建立了耦合平动与转动的三维活性布朗运动理论框架，给出了低阶位移矩的解析近似，并通过数值模拟验证理论预测。

papers.title: Self-Generated Electric Fields in Polyelectrolyte Gradients Increase Microparticle Transport
papers.abstract: There are many situations in nature and industry where small particles are exposed to gradients of charged polymers, such as enzymes in biological gradients of DNA or RNA, virus particles in respiratory droplets, and colloidal particles in stratifying paint layers. Here, we study the phoretic propulsion of charged microparticles in a polyelectrolyte gradient. We theoretically predict the emergence of a macroscopic electric field from charge-separation dynamics in a polyelectrolyte gradient under a continuous diffusive driving force. We confirm the presence of this self-generated electric field experimentally and show that it significantly increases the phoretic velocity of the microparticles. Finally, for high molecular weight polyelectrolytes we observe that propulsion becomes gradient-independent, consistent with diffusiophoretic predictions for asymmetric electrolytes. Our results show that self-generated electric fields in polyelectrolyte gradients can enhance microparticle transport, with potential applicability wherever charged species of different mobility are continuously driven out of equilibrium.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论预测 + 实验验证）。关键词：theoretically predict、confirm experimentally、consistent with diffusiophoretic predictions。；研究对象：带电微粒在聚电解质梯度中的自生电场与扩散泳输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 聚电解质梯度中电荷分离动力学会产生宏观自生电场，该电场显著增强带电微粒的扩散泳速度；对于高分子量聚电解质，推进速度变得与梯度无关，符合不对称电解质的扩散泳预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：聚电解质梯度中电荷分离动力学会产生宏观自生电场，该电场显著增强带电微粒的扩散泳速度；对于高分子量聚电解质，推进速度变得与梯度无关，符合不对称电解质的扩散泳预测。；创新点：首次理论预测并实验证实聚电解质梯度中自生电场的存在及其对微粒输运的增强作用，揭示了与不对称电解质扩散泳行为的一致性。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（基于电荷分离动力学与连续扩散驱动力模型）与实验观测（测量带电微粒在聚电解质梯度中的泳动速度）相结合。

papers.title: Proximity-Induced Skyrmion Stabilization at the Cu2OSeO3/Bi2Se3 Interface
papers.abstract: We investigate proximity-induced magnetic interactions at the interface between the topological insulator Bi2Se3 and the chiral magnetic insulator Cu2OSeO3, with particular focus on the low temperature skyrmion phase. Broadband ferromagnetic resonance spectroscopy reveals enhanced stability of noncollinear spin textures in the Cu2OSeO3/Bi2Se3 heterostructure compared with bare Cu2OSeO3. In addition to an extra resonance mode in the tilted conical phase that is absent in bare Cu2OSeO3, field cycling resolves two counterclockwise skyrmion resonance branches separated by approximately 238 MHz, consistent with the coexistence of a bulk skyrmion lattice and an interfacial skyrmion phase stabilized by proximity-induced exchange coupling and enhanced interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions. The finite frequency separation indicates that the two skyrmion phases occupy distinct magnetic energy landscapes while retaining similar resonance character. Resonant elastic x-ray scattering measurements further confirm that the interfacial skyrmion phase spans a broader magnetic-field range than the bulk phase, demonstrating enhanced stability and ordering of topological spin textures at the interface. These findings establish interface engineering as a promising route for extending the stability regime of skyrmion and tilted-conical phases in topological-magnetic heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：broadband ferromagnetic resonance spectroscopy、field cycling、resonant elastic x-ray scattering measurements。；研究对象：拓扑绝缘体Bi₂Se₃与手性磁绝缘体Cu₂OSeO₃构成的异质结界面，特别是低温下的斯格明子相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Cu₂OSeO₃/Bi₂Se₃异质结中，界面处由邻近效应诱导的交换耦合和增强的Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用稳定了界面斯格明子相，使其比体相斯格明子具有更宽的磁场稳定范围和更高的有序性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Cu₂OSeO₃/Bi₂Se₃异质结中，界面处由邻近效应诱导的交换耦合和增强的Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用稳定了界面斯格明子相，使其比体相斯格明子具有更宽的磁场稳定范围和更高的有序性。；创新点：通过界面工程在拓扑绝缘体/手性磁绝缘体异质结中实现了斯格明子相的稳定性和有序性的显著增强，并实验证实了体相斯格明子晶格与界面斯格明子相共存于不同的磁能景观中。
papers.method_zh: 宽带铁磁共振谱学、场循环测量、共振弹性X射线散射。

papers.title: Giant perpendicular Edelstein polarization in 2D compensated magnets via bichromatic Floquet driving
papers.abstract: While unconventional $p$-wave magnets can generate nonrelativistic Edelstein polarizations, spin-group symmetries strictly forbid these responses in unconventional magnets with higher-order harmonics, such as $d$-wave altermagnets. Here, we demonstrate that combining Rashba spin-orbit coupling with bichromatic Floquet driving activates giant perpendicular Edelstein polarizations (PEPs) across 2D altermagnets and broader classes of unconventional spin-polarized magnets -- a feat monochromatic driving cannot achieve. By dynamically breaking two-fold rotational symmetry, the two-frequency drive (including bilinear, bicircular, and circular-linear configurations) induces a stray-field-free in-plane Zeeman-like field that generates orbitally dominated PEPs (0.5--1.5 $μ_{\rm B}$). This massive response is governed by universal selection rules tied to the system's magnetic parity and the second beam's harmonics. These emergent PEPs provide a powerful mechanism for perpendicular memory writing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“demonstrate”“induce”“governed by universal selection rules”等理论推导和机制分析关键词，未提及实验手段或计算模拟。；研究对象：二维补偿磁体（包括d波交错磁体及更广泛非常规自旋极化磁体）中，通过双色Floquet驱动产生的巨大垂直Edelstein极化（PEP）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 结合Rashba自旋轨道耦合与双色Floquet驱动（如双线性、双圆偏振、圆-线偏振组合），可在二维交错磁体及更广泛的非常规自旋极化磁体中激活巨大的垂直Edelstein极化（0.5–1.5 μB），而单色驱动无法实现。该极化由轨道主导，受系统磁宇称和第二束光谐波的普适选择定则控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：结合Rashba自旋轨道耦合与双色Floquet驱动（如双线性、双圆偏振、圆-线偏振组合），可在二维交错磁体及更广泛的非常规自旋极化磁体中激活巨大的垂直Edelstein极化（0.5–1.5 μB），而单色驱动无法实现。该极化由轨道主导，受系统磁宇称和第二束光谐波的普适选择定则控制。；创新点：首次证明双色Floquet驱动（而非单色驱动）能够克服自旋群对称性对高阶谐波非常规磁体中Edelstein极化的严格禁止，从而在二维交错磁体中实现巨大的垂直极化，为无杂散场的垂直磁存储写入提供新机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：基于Floquet理论处理双色光驱动，结合自旋群对称性分析，推导出动态破缺二重旋转对称性所诱导的面内类Zeeman场，并计算由此产生的轨道主导Edelstein极化。

papers.title: Anomalous Hall Effect Driven by Chiral Superconductivity
papers.abstract: Direct dc-current signatures of unconventional superconductivity remain scarce. Existing probes of unconventional pairing are typically indirect, relying on phase-diagram anomalies, responses to external fields, or optical measurements. Here we propose a zero-field Hall drag effect as a direct transport signature of chiral superconductivity. The effect arises from Coulomb drag between quasiparticles in a chiral superconductor and those in an adjacent time-reversal-symmetric normal layer. We develop a minimal hydrodynamic theory that includes both quasiparticle normal current and condensate supercurrent in the superconducting layer. In an open-circuit superconducting layer, the condensate generates a counterflowing supercurrent that cancels the net layer current, while a finite quasiparticle current remains and mediates the transverse drag response. This results in anomalous Hall voltage signal appearing abruptly when $T$ is lowered below $T_c$, of the sign reflecting the sign of the superconducting order parameter phase winding.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“propose”、“develop a minimal hydrodynamic theory”等关键词，表明该工作主要基于理论构建和推导，而非实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：手性超导体（chiral superconductor）与相邻时间反演对称正常层（time-reversal-symmetric normal layer）构成的异质结体系中的零场霍尔拖曳效应（zero-field Hall drag effect）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种零场霍尔拖曳效应，可作为手性超导的直接直流输运特征信号。该效应表现为当温度降至超导转变温度（Tc）以下时，正常层中会突然出现一个反常霍尔电压信号，其符号反映了超导序参量相位缠绕的方向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种零场霍尔拖曳效应，可作为手性超导的直接直流输运特征信号。该效应表现为当温度降至超导转变温度（Tc）以下时，正常层中会突然出现一个反常霍尔电压信号，其符号反映了超导序参量相位缠绕的方向。；创新点：提出了一个全新的、直接的直流输运信号（零场霍尔拖曳）来探测手性超导，区别于现有主要依赖间接手段（如相图异常、外场响应、光学测量）的探测方法。
papers.method_zh: 发展了一个最小流体动力学理论（minimal hydrodynamic theory），该理论同时考虑了超导层中的准粒子正常电流（quasiparticle normal current）和凝聚体超流（condensate supercurrent）。通过分析开路超导层中凝聚体产生的反向超流与剩余准粒子电流之间的耦合，推导了横向拖曳响应。

papers.title: Universal Spectral Mirage Gaps in Superconductors with Time-Reversal-Symmetric Spin-Orbit Coupling
papers.abstract: Spectral mirage gaps, regarded as evidence of finite-energy pairing correlations, have so far been mainly studied in superconductors with Ising spin-orbit coupling (SOC). Here, we show that superconductors with any time-reversal-symmetric SOC can generate mirage gaps near the SOC energy scale when the applied magnetic field has a component perpendicular to the SOC texture, whereas the parallel component produces Zeeman-split spectral features near the superconducting gap. We demonstrate this general principle in superconductors with Rashba and Rashba-Ising SOC. These universal field-dependent signatures establish superconducting spectroscopy as a powerful probe of SOC textures and strengths.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show、demonstrate、general principle。；研究对象：具有时间反演对称自旋轨道耦合（SOC）的超导体中的光谱幻影能隙（spectral mirage gaps）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有任意时间反演对称自旋轨道耦合的超导体中，当外加磁场具有垂直于SOC纹理的分量时，会在SOC能标附近产生幻影能隙；而平行分量则会在超导能隙附近产生塞曼分裂的光谱特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有任意时间反演对称自旋轨道耦合的超导体中，当外加磁场具有垂直于SOC纹理的分量时，会在SOC能标附近产生幻影能隙；而平行分量则会在超导能隙附近产生塞曼分裂的光谱特征。；创新点：将此前主要局限于Ising型自旋轨道耦合超导体的幻影能隙现象，推广至任意时间反演对称的自旋轨道耦合体系，并揭示了磁场方向与SOC纹理的相对取向对光谱特征的普适性影响。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与推导，具体以Rashba和Rashba-Ising型自旋轨道耦合超导体为例进行演示。

papers.title: Optimal interactions for addressable self-assembly
papers.abstract: Addressable self-assembly asks that each building block assemble into a particular location in a target structure. Although particles may all be distinct, achieving high yield is a challenge because of monomer depletion: more target structures can nucleate than there are building blocks for, so they form partial fragments which cannot complete growth. We ask how to design the interactions between building blocks to achieve the highest yield in a given time. Using reaction equations describing all the intermediate steps of assembly, combined with numerical optimization, we show that the optimal interactions are such that (i) all bonds are either very strong or very weak, and (ii) the strong bonds form a spanning tree of the target structure. We then prove that when interactions form a spanning tree, monomer depletion cannot occur: assembly can always proceed downhill in energy space, with no kinetic traps. This result is a combinatorial property of the underlying interaction graph, and does not depend on the particular model for the kinetics. It suggests a robust design principle: create a network of strong interactions that has no loops, and make all other interactions much weaker. We validate this principle in numerical simulations of larger structures, and we further show that spanning trees that are more compact have typically better yield. Our results suggest a new framework for understanding monomer depletion and addressable self-assembly, which may be applied to DNA nanotechnology and which may give insight into the assembly pathways of certain multiprotein complexes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：reaction equations、numerical optimization、prove、combinatorial property）；研究对象：可寻址自组装（addressable self-assembly）中构建块之间的相互作用设计，具体涉及单体耗尽（monomer depletion）问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 最优相互作用设计应使所有键要么极强要么极弱，且强键形成目标结构的生成树（spanning tree），从而避免单体耗尽，使组装始终沿能量下坡进行，无动力学陷阱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：最优相互作用设计应使所有键要么极强要么极弱，且强键形成目标结构的生成树（spanning tree），从而避免单体耗尽，使组装始终沿能量下坡进行，无动力学陷阱。；创新点：提出了一个鲁棒的设计原则：创建无环的强相互作用网络，并使其他相互作用弱得多；该原则不依赖于具体的动力学模型，并进一步发现更紧凑的生成树通常具有更高的产率。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 使用描述组装所有中间步骤的反应方程（reaction equations），结合数值优化（numerical optimization），并对相互作用图（interaction graph）进行组合性质证明。

papers.title: A technical report on the surface-energy and morphology-based screening for electrode/electrolyte interface compatibility in SOFC/ReSOC materials
papers.abstract: The performance and durability of solid oxide fuel cells and reversible solid oxide cells are strongly affected by the electrode-electrolyte interface, where charge transfer, ionic transport, adhesion, morphology and thermomechanical stability interact. Early-stage compatibility screening is usually based on electrochemical or compositional criteria, whereas surface-related descriptors are rarely included in a unified framework. This work proposes a surface-based methodology to assess the expected compatibility of candidate electrode-electrolyte pairings. Contact-angle measurements with water and glycerol are used to determine total, dispersive and polar surface free energy components through the Owens-Wendt-Rabel-Kaelble method. Confocal topography is used to extract ISO 25178 roughness parameters, including average roughness, peak-to-valley height, valley depth, skewness, kurtosis and surface slope. A compatibility matrix is constructed by combining energetic affinity and morphological suitability, with emphasis on the electrolyte surface, since the electrode is deposited directly onto the electrolyte substrate. The results indicate that the most promising interfaces are not necessarily those with the highest surface free energy, but those combining high adhesion work, low interfacial energy and a substrate morphology suitable for continuous electrode deposition. The proposed approach provides a rational pre-electrochemical screening tool to prioritize electrode-electrolyte combinations for subsequent validation by electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, area specific resistance, electrical contact resistance, microstructural analysis and durability testing. Although it does not replace electrochemical characterization, it offers a physically grounded way to connect surface chemistry, topography and interface formation in solid oxide cell materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：contact-angle measurements（接触角测量）、confocal topography（共聚焦形貌测量）、Owens-Wendt-Rabel-Kaelble method（OWRK方法）。；研究对象：固体氧化物燃料电池（SOFC）和可逆固体氧化物电池（ReSOC）中的电极/电解质界面兼容性，具体涉及电解质表面（如氧化钇稳定氧化锆等）与电极材料之间的界面形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 最理想的电极/电解质界面并非具有最高表面自由能的组合，而是那些兼具高粘附功、低界面能以及适合连续电极沉积的电解质表面形貌的组合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：最理想的电极/电解质界面并非具有最高表面自由能的组合，而是那些兼具高粘附功、低界面能以及适合连续电极沉积的电解质表面形貌的组合。；创新点：将表面能（包括色散和极性分量）和表面形貌参数纳入统一的预电化学筛选框架，而传统早期兼容性筛选通常仅基于电化学或成分标准，很少系统考虑表面相关描述符。
papers.method_zh: 采用接触角测量（水和甘油）通过OWRK方法计算表面自由能的总量、色散分量和极性分量；使用共聚焦形貌测量提取ISO 25178粗糙度参数（平均粗糙度、峰谷高度、谷深、偏度、峰度、表面斜率）；构建结合能量亲和性与形貌适宜性的兼容性矩阵。

papers.title: The exceptional origin of the strange metal and the LFL-HFL transition
papers.abstract: We propose an algebraic framework for the strange metal regime of strongly correlated electrons. We show that the exceptional superconformal algebra $D(2,1;α)$ admits two distinct contractions of its conformal sector: one to a pair of canonical fermions, the underlying degrees of freedom of the Landau-Fermi liquid (LFL), and one to the algebra of Hubbard operators, which characterise a distinct metallic regime, the Hubbard-Fermi liquid (HFL). We argue that competition between these two metallic states drives the emergence of the strange metal as a $0+1$D superconformal bath. We analyse the resulting thermodynamics, and obtain a parameter-free prediction, $4π^2γ^{-1} =χ_s^{-1} + χ_c^{-1}$, relating the Sommerfeld coefficient to the static spin and charge susceptibilities. We further show that the LFL-HFL transition is discontinuous at low temperature, owing to a degeneracy at the emergence of the HFL, and map out the resulting phase diagram. We connect the framework to microscopic lattice models and to the phenomenology of correlated insulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：algebraic framework、propose、argue、analyse。；研究对象：强关联电子体系中的奇异金属（strange metal）态，以及Landau-Fermi液体（LFL）与Hubbard-Fermi液体（HFL）之间的相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 奇异金属态源于LFL与HFL两种金属态之间的竞争，表现为一个0+1维的超共形浴；该理论给出了一个无参数预测：\(4\pi^2\gamma^{-1} = \chi_s^{-1} + \chi_c^{-1}\)，将索末菲系数与静态自旋和电荷磁化率联系起来。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：奇异金属态源于LFL与HFL两种金属态之间的竞争，表现为一个0+1维的超共形浴；该理论给出了一个无参数预测：\(4\pi^2\gamma^{-1} = \chi_s^{-1} + \chi_c^{-1}\)，将索末菲系数与静态自旋和电荷磁化率联系起来。；创新点：首次将例外超共形代数 \(D(2,1;\alpha)\) 的收缩机制与奇异金属的涌现联系起来，并给出了LFL-HFL转变在低温下不连续（由于HFL涌现时的简并性）的明确理论预言。摘要未突出说明与已有具体模型或实验的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用代数框架，具体基于例外超共形代数 \(D(2,1;\alpha)\) 的两种不同收缩：一种收缩到描述Landau-Fermi液体的正则费米子代数，另一种收缩到描述Hubbard-Fermi液体的Hubbard算符代数。通过分析该代数结构下的热力学性质推导出相图。

papers.title: Nonlinear diffusion and compressive rims in source-driven biopolymer condensates
papers.abstract: Many subcellular condensates continuously produce biopolymers. Coupling Flory-Huggins thermodynamics to two-fluid viscoelasticity, we probe the diffusion of such source-driven polymeric droplets, and identify a universal structural compressive rim at their diffusion front. Integrating analytical scaling laws, numerical simulations, and experimental data, we show that this framework captures key structural and dynamic characteristics of the nucleolus, demonstrating the role of polymer diffusion in non-equilibrium biological transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算与实验数据支持）。判断依据：关键词“coupling Flory-Huggins thermodynamics to two-fluid viscoelasticity”、“analytical scaling laws”、“numerical simulations”以及“experimental data”。；研究对象：源驱动（source-driven）的生物聚合物凝聚体，特别是核仁（nucleolus）中聚合物的非平衡扩散与结构演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在源驱动的聚合物液滴扩散前沿，存在一个普遍的结构性压缩边缘（compressive rim）。该框架成功捕捉了核仁的关键结构与动力学特征，揭示了聚合物扩散在非平衡生物输运中的作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在源驱动的聚合物液滴扩散前沿，存在一个普遍的结构性压缩边缘（compressive rim）。该框架成功捕捉了核仁的关键结构与动力学特征，揭示了聚合物扩散在非平衡生物输运中的作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将Flory-Huggins热力学与双流体粘弹性理论（two-fluid viscoelasticity）相耦合。分析方法：解析标度律（analytical scaling laws）。数值方法：数值模拟（numerical simulations）。实验验证：引用并分析实验数据（experimental data）。

papers.title: Energy-time entanglement from a monolithically integrated quantum dot on silicon
papers.abstract: Scalable quantum photonic technologies require deterministic sources of entangled photons that are compatible with established semiconductor manufacturing platforms. While self-assembled III--V semiconductor quantum dots are among the most promising sources of on-demand entanglement generation, their integration with silicon-based architectures remains a central challenge. Here, we demonstrate energy--time entanglement from a single InGaAs/GaAs quantum dot monolithically grown on a silicon substrate. Under coherent two-photon excitation, we achieve coherent control of the biexciton--exciton cascade, evidenced by Rabi oscillations and dressed-state formation. Using a four-channel Franson interferometer, we observe phase-dependent two-photon interference with visibilities up to $(64.0 \pm 7.0)\%$ for an 80 ps integration window (and $(49.4 \pm 1.9)\%$ for a 1600 ps window), approaching the threshold for Bell inequality violation at short time scales. These results establish monolithically integrated III--V-on-silicon quantum dots as promising sources of energy--time entangled photons for scalable quantum photonic technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：demonstrate、observed、measured、Franson interferometer。；研究对象：单片集成在硅衬底上的InGaAs/GaAs量子点，以及其产生的能量-时间纠缠光子对。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在硅衬底上单片集成的III-V族量子点中实现了能量-时间纠缠，通过Franson干涉仪观测到最高(64.0 ± 7.0)%的相位依赖双光子干涉可见度，在短时间窗口内接近贝尔不等式违背阈值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在硅衬底上单片集成的III-V族量子点中实现了能量-时间纠缠，通过Franson干涉仪观测到最高(64.0 ± 7.0)%的相位依赖双光子干涉可见度，在短时间窗口内接近贝尔不等式违背阈值。；创新点：首次在单片集成于硅衬底的量子点中实现能量-时间纠缠，解决了III-V族量子点与硅基架构集成的关键挑战，为可扩展量子光子技术提供了确定性纠缠光源。
papers.method_zh: 采用相干双光子激发实现双激子-激子级联的相干控制（通过拉比振荡和缀饰态形成验证），并使用四通道Franson干涉仪测量能量-时间纠缠的双光子干涉可见度。

papers.title: Strain-Tunable Harmonic Responses in Valley-Polarized Bilayer Graphene
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate the linear and second-order nonlinear optical responses of valley-polarized bilayer graphene under uniaxial strain. Employing a low-energy effective Hamiltonian that incorporates trigonal warping and strain-induced anisotropy, we calculate the optical susceptibilities within the quantum kinetic formalism. We show that, while the second-order response vanishes in valley-balanced bilayer graphene owing to the cancellation of contributions from opposite valleys, a finite valley polarization lifts this cancellation and enables a net second-harmonic generation (SHG) signal. Uniaxial strain substantially modifies the nonlinear response by distorting the low-energy electronic structure and altering the pseudospin texture, producing a highly anisotropic SHG spectrum. Pronounced resonant enhancements occur at photon energies $\hbarω\approx E_f$ and $\hbarω\approx 2E_f$, associated with two-photon and one-photon interband resonances, respectively. Remarkably, changing the sign of the strain parameter reverses the direction of the induced second-harmonic current, providing a mechanically controlled switching mechanism for nonlinear optical transport. These results establish strain engineering as an effective route for manipulating valley-dependent nonlinear optical phenomena in bilayer graphene and suggest new opportunities for tunable mid-infrared photonic and valley-optoelectronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“theoretically investigate”、“calculate”、“quantum kinetic formalism”。；研究对象：谷极化双层石墨烯在单轴应变下的线性和二阶非线性光学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 谷极化可以打破双层石墨烯中由于相反谷贡献抵消导致的二阶非线性响应消失，从而产生净二次谐波信号；单轴应变可以显著调控该非线性响应，甚至通过改变应变符号来反转二次谐波电流的方向，实现机械控制的开关效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：谷极化可以打破双层石墨烯中由于相反谷贡献抵消导致的二阶非线性响应消失，从而产生净二次谐波信号；单轴应变可以显著调控该非线性响应，甚至通过改变应变符号来反转二次谐波电流的方向，实现机械控制的开关效应。；创新点：揭示了应变工程作为调控双层石墨烯中谷依赖非线性光学现象的有效手段，特别是发现了通过改变应变符号来机械控制二次谐波电流方向的新机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用包含三角翘曲和应变诱导各向异性的低能有效哈密顿量，在量子动力学框架下计算光学极化率。

papers.title: Optimizing Ti substitution for the enhanced densification, ionic conductivity, and microstructure of garnet-type Li$_7$La$_3$Zr$_2$O$_{12}$ solid electrolytes
papers.abstract: Garnet-type lithium lanthanum zirconium oxide Li$_7$La$_3$Zr$_2$O$_{12}$ (LLZO) is a favorable solid electrolyte for all-solid-state Li-ion batteries due to its wide electrochemical stability, compatible ionic conductivity, and good safety. However, further improvement in ionic conductivity is required for its practical applications. In this work, titanium (Ti) is doped into LLZO to enhance its Li-ion transport properties and structural stability. The series Li$_7$La$_3$Zr$_{2-x}$Ti$_x$O$_{12}$ has been successfully synthesized using conventional solid-state reaction method. The content of Ti has been varied from 0 to 0.20 atoms per formula unit (a.p.f.u). The conducting cubic phase has been confirmed by the X-ray diffraction technique (XRD). Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and energy dispersive spectroscopy (EDS) have been used for structural analysis, and elemental distribution. Density measurements have been carried out for all the samples. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy revealed that the high ionic conductivity of $8.08\times 10^{-5}$ Scm$^{-1}$ is offered by the Li$_7$La$_3$Zr$_{1.9}$Ti$_{0.1}$O$_{12}$ sample, which has the lowest activation energy of 0.37 eV. The DC polarization analysis verified that the main contribution to conductivity in the 0.10 Ti sample comes from ions. A one order of magnitude increase in room temperature ionic conductivity is observed for the 0.10 Ti sample, making it a strong candidate for solid electrolyte applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要明确提到“成功合成”、“X射线衍射（XRD）”、“扫描电子显微镜（SEM）”、“电化学阻抗谱”等实验手段。；研究对象：钛（Ti）掺杂的 garnet 型固态电解质 Li₇La₃Zr₂O₁₂（LLZO），具体为 Li₇La₃Zr₂₋ₓTiₓO₁₂ 系列材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当 Ti 掺杂量为 0.10 原子每分子式单元（a.p.f.u）时，样品 Li₇La₃Zr₁.₉Ti₀.₁O₁₂ 在室温下表现出最高离子电导率（8.08×10⁻⁵ S/cm）和最低活化能（0.37 eV），相比未掺杂样品离子电导率提升了一个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当 Ti 掺杂量为 0.10 原子每分子式单元（a.p.f.u）时，样品 Li₇La₃Zr₁.₉Ti₀.₁O₁₂ 在室温下表现出最高离子电导率（8.08×10⁻⁵ S/cm）和最低活化能（0.37 eV），相比未掺杂样品离子电导率提升了一个数量级。；创新点：系统研究了不同 Ti 掺杂量（0 至 0.20 a.p.f.u）对 LLZO 致密化、离子电导率和微观结构的影响，并发现 0.10 Ti 掺杂量可实现离子电导率一个数量级的提升，为优化 garnet 型固态电解质性能提供了具体掺杂策略。
papers.method_zh: 采用传统固相反应法合成系列样品；使用 X 射线衍射（XRD）确认导电立方相；利用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和能量色散 X 射线光谱（EDS）进行结构分析和元素分布表征；对所有样品进行密度测量；通过电化学阻抗谱（EIS）测量离子电导率；采用直流极化分析验证离子导电主导性。

papers.title: Suppressing Parametric Instabilities in Driven Bosonic Lattices through Multi-tone Control
papers.abstract: Periodically driven quantum systems offer remarkable flexibility in tailoring effective Hamiltonians and synthetic band structures. However, such driving also induces heating and dynamical instabilities that limit the coherence and lifetime of many-body states. Here, we demonstrate that these instabilities can be suppressed by employing multi-tone driving schemes. Using a Bose-Einstein condensate of cesium atoms in an optical lattice, we experimentally explore two approaches: pulsed driving composed of odd harmonics and two-tone driving with tunable amplitude and relative phase. We show that both methods allow independent control of the effective tunneling amplitude and Peierls phase factor, while significantly reducing phonon excitation and the resulting rapid decay of the condensate. Numerical simulations and theoretical modeling based on Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations confirm the suppression of unstable modes under optimized driving conditions. Our results establish multifrequency drives as powerful tools for stabilizing driven many-body systems and pave the way toward robust Floquet engineering with interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（兼有数值模拟和理论建模）。判断依据关键词：experimentally explore、Bose-Einstein condensate、optical lattice、Numerical simulations、theoretical modeling。；研究对象：驱动玻色子晶格中的参量不稳定性，具体体系为光晶格中的铯原子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过采用多频驱动方案（奇次谐波脉冲驱动和双频驱动），可以有效抑制驱动玻色子晶格中的加热和动力学不稳定性，从而显著延长凝聚体的相干寿命。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过采用多频驱动方案（奇次谐波脉冲驱动和双频驱动），可以有效抑制驱动玻色子晶格中的加热和动力学不稳定性，从而显著延长凝聚体的相干寿命。；创新点：首次实验证明多频驱动（而非传统单频驱动）可以独立控制有效隧穿振幅和Peierls相位因子，同时大幅抑制声子激发和凝聚体的快速衰变，为稳定驱动多体系统提供了新工具。
papers.method_zh: 实验上利用光晶格中的铯原子BEC，实施两种多频驱动方案：由奇次谐波组成的脉冲驱动，以及振幅和相对相位可调的双频驱动。理论上基于Bogoliubov-de Gennes方程进行数值模拟和理论建模，以验证不稳定模的抑制效果。

papers.title: Activated dynamics in the quantum random field Ising model
papers.abstract: We study the critical dynamics of the quantum random-field Ising model using the nonperturbative functional renormalization group (NP-FRG). The static critical behavior is found to be controlled by the zero-temperature fixed point of the classical random-field Ising model, where both thermal and quantum fluctuations are dangerously irrelevant. Considering a family of quantum dynamical universality classes defined by a bare dynamical kernel $F_Λ(ω)\sim |ω|^σ$, we show how this fluctuationless fixed point nevertheless controls the quantum dynamics by computing the full Matsubara-frequency dependence of the running dynamical kernel $F_k(ω)$. This is essential at zero temperature: a naive treatment of the dynamical kernel flow leads to a divergence at a finite length scale, resulting in apparent localization. In contrast, keeping the full frequency dependence of the dynamical kernel and choosing a regulator adapted to its running scale yields a controlled flow. The resulting dynamics is of activated form, with a relaxation time given by $\ln τ\sim ξ^Ψ$. The exponent $Ψ$ is determined by the static RFIM fixed-point exponents and by $σ$. At finite temperature, the flow crosses over to the classical thermally activated scaling of the random-field Ising model. These results provide a quantitative field-theoretic realization of the heuristic activation scenario proposed earlier for the quantum random-field model and establish a framework for analyzing the dynamics of other disordered quantum systems that may exhibit similar tentative localization-like singularities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用非微扰泛函重整化群（NP-FRG）进行理论分析，未涉及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：量子随机场伊辛模型（quantum random-field Ising model）的临界动力学行为，特别是零温与有限温下的弛豫机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子随机场伊辛模型的动力学由经典随机场伊辛模型的零温不动点控制，弛豫时间呈现激活形式（\(\ln \tau \sim \xi^\Psi\)），其中指数 \(\Psi\) 由静态临界指数和动力学核的幂指数 \(\sigma\) 共同决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子随机场伊辛模型的动力学由经典随机场伊辛模型的零温不动点控制，弛豫时间呈现激活形式（\(\ln \tau \sim \xi^\Psi\)），其中指数 \(\Psi\) 由静态临界指数和动力学核的幂指数 \(\sigma\) 共同决定。；创新点：首次通过定量场论框架实现了对量子随机场模型早期提出的“激活动力学”启发式图景的严格计算，并揭示了动力学核频率依赖性的完整处理对于避免虚假局域化奇点至关重要。
papers.method_zh: 非微扰泛函重整化群（NP-FRG）方法，通过计算完整松原频率依赖的动力学核 \(F_k(\omega)\) 的流动，并采用适应其运行尺度的调节函数，避免了有限尺度下的发散（即表观局域化）。

papers.title: Universal scaling of many-body effects in quantum tunneling
papers.abstract: Quantum tunneling is fundamental to diverse phenomena and underpins a wide range of modern technologies. In the study of superconducting quantum computation and high-temperature superconducting materials, tunneling on multi-particle scale is central. Recently, several cold atom experiments successfully simulated the tunneling process in a many-particle ensemble. However, the many-body nature remains largely unexplored. Here, we observe the universal scaling of many-body effects in quantum tunneling process, using a hexagonal-triangular quantum simulator with independent control of barrier, temperature and interaction. In the weak-interaction regime, the critical tunneling coefficient scales parabolically with temperature under various conditions, in contrast to the linear scaling of single-particle tunneling. By further increasing the interactions beyond the mean-field regime, the scaling exponent decreases, consistent with quantum field theory predictions. Our results address the fundamental question of how many-body effects renormalize quantum tunneling, with direct implications for correlated quantum matter and devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：quantum simulator, observed, cold atom experiments）；研究对象：多粒子量子隧穿过程中的多体效应，具体使用六角-三角量子模拟器研究相互作用、温度和势垒对隧穿行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱相互作用区域，多体隧穿的临界隧穿系数随温度呈抛物线标度，而非单粒子隧穿的线性标度；当相互作用增强至平均场区域以上时，标度指数下降，与量子场论预言一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱相互作用区域，多体隧穿的临界隧穿系数随温度呈抛物线标度，而非单粒子隧穿的线性标度；当相互作用增强至平均场区域以上时，标度指数下降，与量子场论预言一致。；创新点：首次实验观测到多体效应在量子隧穿中的普适标度行为，揭示了多体效应如何重整化量子隧穿这一基本问题。
papers.method_zh: 使用六角-三角量子模拟器，独立控制势垒、温度和相互作用，通过冷原子实验模拟多粒子隧穿过程。

papers.title: Mesoscopic simulations of linear and ring polymer solutions with explicit hydrodynamics under good and poor solvent conditions
papers.abstract: We employ large-scale Dissipative Particle Dynamics simulations to investigate dilute solutions of linear polymers and unknotted, non-concatenated ring polymers in explicit solvent. By systematically varying solvent quality, we examine the interplay between hydrodynamic interactions, chain architecture, and intermolecular association. Under good solvent conditions, both linear and ring polymers remain expanded and well dispersed, displaying center-of-mass dynamics consistent with normal diffusion. In poor solvents, attractive polymer-polymer interactions drive the formation of irregular aggregates characterized by partial chain collapse, substantial interpenetration, and slower dynamics. Despite their different topologies, the two polymer architectures exhibit remarkably similar structural and dynamical responses across the solvent conditions considered. These results indicate that solvent quality largely determines the organization and transport properties of dilute polymer solutions, whereas topological effects remain comparatively weak in the investigated regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“Dissipative Particle Dynamics simulations”（耗散粒子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：稀溶液中线性聚合物与未成结、非连锁环状聚合物的结构及动力学行为，重点考察溶剂质量（良溶剂与不良溶剂）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在良溶剂条件下，两种聚合物均保持膨胀并良好分散，质心运动符合正常扩散；在不良溶剂中，聚合物间吸引导致形成部分塌缩、相互穿透的不规则聚集体，动力学变慢。尽管拓扑结构不同，两者在结构及动力学响应上表现出高度相似性，表明溶剂质量主导稀溶液性质，而拓扑效应在该研究范围内相对较弱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在良溶剂条件下，两种聚合物均保持膨胀并良好分散，质心运动符合正常扩散；在不良溶剂中，聚合物间吸引导致形成部分塌缩、相互穿透的不规则聚集体，动力学变慢。尽管拓扑结构不同，两者在结构及动力学响应上表现出高度相似性，表明溶剂质量主导稀溶液性质，而拓扑效应在该研究范围内相对较弱。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 大规模耗散粒子动力学（DPD）模拟，显式溶剂模型，系统改变溶剂质量以调控聚合物-聚合物相互作用。

papers.title: Local magnon modes studied by dynamic magnetic pair-density function analysis
papers.abstract: The dynamic magnetic pair-density function (DymPDF) $D_{\rm M}(r, E)$ is obtained via the Fourier transform of the dynamic magnetic structure factor, $S_{\rm M}(Q, E)$, which is measured using nonpolarized inelastic neutron scattering. While there is a long history of magnetic excitation studies with $S_{\rm M}(Q, E)$, there are no reports on $D_{\rm M}(r, E)$. In this study, we examine simple magnet models and representative magnet examples, such as FeTiO$_{3}$ and YBa$_{2}$Cu$_{3}$O$_{6}$, to investigate the real-space dynamics of $D_{\rm M}(r, E)$. We derive the $D_{\rm M}(r, E)$ equations for simple magnet models in a low energy limit. By comparing these equations to the simulations, we demonstrate the characteristic energy dependence of real-space local magnon modes, including the transition of the magnon mode from acoustic to optical. Our novel analysis reveals the local magnon modes accompanied by a sign change in each spin-pair correlation at a given energy in nanoscale real space even under non-periodic conditions. This method is unique for studying local magnetic dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：derive equations、simulations、Fourier transform。；研究对象：动态磁对分布函数（DymPDF）在实空间中的局域磁振子模式，具体以简单磁模型以及FeTiO₃和YBa₂Cu₃O₆为代表材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过动态磁对分布函数分析，揭示了实空间局域磁振子模式的特征能量依赖关系，包括磁振子模式从声学到光学的转变，以及在非周期条件下纳米尺度实空间中自旋对关联随能量发生符号变化的局域磁振子模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过动态磁对分布函数分析，揭示了实空间局域磁振子模式的特征能量依赖关系，包括磁振子模式从声学到光学的转变，以及在非周期条件下纳米尺度实空间中自旋对关联随能量发生符号变化的局域磁振子模式。；创新点：首次报道了动态磁对分布函数D_M(r, E)在实空间中的研究，该方法为研究局域磁动力学提供了独特途径。
papers.method_zh: 利用非极化非弹性中子散射测量动态磁结构因子S_M(Q, E)，再通过傅里叶变换得到动态磁对分布函数D_M(r, E)；对简单磁模型在低能极限下推导D_M(r, E)的解析方程，并与数值模拟结果进行对比分析。

papers.title: Effects of confinement in a Brownian gas with simultaneous stochastic resetting and dynamically emergent correlations
papers.abstract: We study $N$ non-interacting Brownian particles in an external potential under simultaneous stochastic resetting to the origin. Although they do not interact directly, common resets generate strong dynamically emergent correlations (DEC). We analyze how confinement modifies these correlations and the nonequilibrium stationary state for $V(x)=κ|x|^α$, $α\geq0$, focusing mainly on two analytically tractable cases: harmonic confinement (HC), $α=2$, and box confinement (BC), $α\to\infty$. In both cases the stationary state is controlled by the competition between confinement and resetting lengths. We derive exact results for the stationary joint distribution, density, correlations, extreme value statistics (EVS), and gap statistics. While the density behaves similarly in HC and BC, the normalized correlation coefficient differs sharply. In BC it is non-monotonic and overshoots the unconfined value, as hard walls suppress decorrelating trajectories. In HC it instead increases monotonically toward the unconfined limit. For general $α$, the behavior is monotonic for $0<α<α_c=1+\sqrt{5}$ and non-monotonic for $α>α_c$. The difference between HC and BC is also visible in edge observables. In HC, the maximum scales as $M_1=O(\sqrt{\ln N})$ and has a limiting distribution with bounded support and a shape transition controlled by the ratio of the two length scales. In BC, the maximum is at distance $O(1/N)$ from the boundary, as in equilibrium, but its fluctuations have a broad power-law tail with logarithmic corrections. The first gap shows a similar contrast: BC gives a smaller typical gap but stronger anomalous fluctuations than HC. Finally, we extend the EVS analysis to general $α$ and identify, via simulations and scaling arguments, three universality classes: $0\leqα\leq1$, $1<α<\infty$, and the singular limit $α\to\infty$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：研究（study）、推导精确结果（derive exact results）、标度论证（scaling arguments）、模拟（simulations）。；研究对象：在外部势阱中同时经历随机重置到原点的N个无相互作用布朗粒子体系，重点研究势阱约束（谐振势与硬盒势）对动态涌现关联（DEC）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 约束与重置长度的竞争控制非平衡稳态；谐振势与硬盒势下归一化关联函数行为截然不同（硬盒势中非单调且超过无约束值，谐振势中单调趋近无约束极限）；极端值统计存在三种普适类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：约束与重置长度的竞争控制非平衡稳态；谐振势与硬盒势下归一化关联函数行为截然不同（硬盒势中非单调且超过无约束值，谐振势中单调趋近无约束极限）；极端值统计存在三种普适类。；创新点：首次系统揭示无相互作用粒子在同时随机重置下，约束势形状如何定量改变动态涌现关联及极端值统计行为，并识别出三种普适类（0≤α≤1，1<α<∞，α→∞）。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导（精确求解稳态联合分布、密度、关联函数、极端值统计和间隙统计），辅以数值模拟和标度论证。

papers.title: Beating micromagnetic limits on skyrmion stability by long-range frustration
papers.abstract: Skyrmion stability is commonly assumed to scale with skyrmion size or exchange stiffness within micromagnetic models. Here, we demonstrate that long-range exchange frustration can break this paradigm, enhancing the collapse energy barrier without increasing skyrmion size or magnetic energy scale. By mapping the continuum model onto a spin-lattice Hamiltonian, we find that skyrmions with identical micromagnetic parameters can exhibit significantly different energy barriers, depending on their underlying atomistic exchange interactions. We attribute this behavior to saddle point textures, whose pronounced noncollinearity captures long-range frustration beyond the micromagnetic approximation. We further develop an exchange optimization framework to predict that long-range frustration can double the energy barrier in physically realistic conditions, possibly valid for ultrathin films or van der Waals magnets. These results hold across different lattice symmetries, revealing an intrinsic limitation of micromagnetics and establishing long-range frustration engineering as a promising route toward highly stable nanoscale skyrmions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要提到“mapping the continuum model onto a spin-lattice Hamiltonian”、“exchange optimization framework”，以及“results hold across different lattice symmetries”，属于理论建模与数值计算。；研究对象：斯格明子（skyrmion）的稳定性，具体研究长程交换阻挫（long-range exchange frustration）对斯格明子塌缩能垒的影响，涉及超薄膜或范德华磁体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 长程交换阻挫可以打破微磁学模型中斯格明子稳定性与尺寸或交换刚度的正比关系，在不增大斯格明子尺寸或磁能量标度的情况下提高塌缩能垒，从而增强斯格明子的稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：长程交换阻挫可以打破微磁学模型中斯格明子稳定性与尺寸或交换刚度的正比关系，在不增大斯格明子尺寸或磁能量标度的情况下提高塌缩能垒，从而增强斯格明子的稳定性。；创新点：揭示了微磁学近似在处理长程阻挫时的内在局限性，提出“长程阻挫工程”（long-range frustration engineering）作为实现高稳定纳米尺度斯格明子的新途径。摘要未突出说明与具体实验对比或材料实现细节。
papers.method_zh: 将连续介质模型映射到自旋晶格哈密顿量，通过比较不同原子级交换相互作用下的能垒差异，分析鞍点织构（saddle point textures）的非共线特性，并发展交换优化框架（exchange optimization framework）预测能垒提升。

papers.title: Designing bistable nanostructures for target behavior
papers.abstract: Many biological machines function through controlled conformational transitions, yet designing synthetic nanostructures with prescribed dynamical behavior remains a major challenge. Here, we develop a modular inverse-design framework for bistable nanostructures whose function is controlled by an energy profile along a geometric reaction coordinate. Inspired by proteins with rigid domains connected by flexible hinges, we introduce a hinge-arm paradigm in which a small bistable hinge controls the energetics of a conformational transition, while rigid arms map this transition onto the separation between external binding sites. Specifically, we ask which features of a target energy profile can be programmed under different design constraints. We find that the energy barriers and the binding-site separations in the two metastable states can be readily designed, while controlling the location of the transition state or the full shape of the energy profile requires additional design freedom. Using a differentiable design framework, we find that some optimized solutions are numerically inexact but still display the functional behavior for which the target profile was selected, emphasizing the importance of function-based evaluation criteria. These results establish a practical hierarchy of designability for bistable nanostructures and provide a route toward synthetic nanomachines that couple conformational transitions to target behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：inverse-design framework（逆设计框架）、differentiable design framework（可微设计框架）、modular design（模块化设计）。；研究对象：双稳态纳米结构（bistable nanostructures），其功能由沿几何反应坐标的能量分布控制，具体为一种“铰链-臂”范式结构，灵感来源于由柔性铰链连接的刚性结构域蛋白质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双稳态纳米结构中，可以较容易地设计两个亚稳态之间的能垒和结合位点间距，但控制过渡态位置或完整能量分布形状需要更多设计自由度；部分优化解虽数值不精确，但仍能实现目标功能行为，表明基于功能的评价标准更为重要。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双稳态纳米结构中，可以较容易地设计两个亚稳态之间的能垒和结合位点间距，但控制过渡态位置或完整能量分布形状需要更多设计自由度；部分优化解虽数值不精确，但仍能实现目标功能行为，表明基于功能的评价标准更为重要。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用模块化逆设计框架（modular inverse-design framework），结合可微设计框架（differentiable design framework）进行数值优化求解，分析不同设计约束下目标能量分布特征的可编程性。

papers.title: Accelerated development of amorphous InZnO thin films as transparent conductive Cu diffusion barriers
papers.abstract: In light of the increasing supply chain concerns regarding silver for solar cell metallization, the replacement of the silver contacts by copper is desirable. As copper diffuses readily in silicon, deposition of an additional diffusion barrier to protect the respective absorber material stacks is required. We investigate multifunctional layers of transparent conductive oxides (TCOs) from the In-Zn-O system to serve as front electrode and Cu diffusion barrier coating, focusing on purely amorphous layers without grain boundaries to impede copper diffusion. We employ a 2D combinatorial approach to simultaneously screen the Zn/(In+Zn) ratio and the oxygen content in a single materials library deposited by magnetron sputtering without intentional substrate heating. Cu diffusion barrier performance was evaluated by depositing Cu on top of intentionally ultrathin In-Zn-O libraries of 7 nm on silicon wafers and annealing them at temperatures of 200-450°C. Both the formation of copper silicides, as well as the silicon photoluminescence signal were monitored. The first was detected only after the crystallization of the In-Zn-O films and required annealing temperatures of 450°C and above. Even for extended dwell times of 20 h at a relevant process temperature of 200°C, we find no evidence of Cu ingress for most of our fabricated In-Zn-O compositions, whereas Si/Cu stacks without In-Zn-O barriers showed a reduction of their photo-luminescence intensity already after less than 1 h. These results suggest thin amorphous In-Zn-O films with an optimal Zn/(In+Zn) ratio of ~0.12 and intermediate oxygen deficiency as effective transparent conductive Cu diffusion barriers for solar cell applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了通过磁控溅射制备材料库、退火处理、光致发光监测等具体实验操作。；研究对象：非晶In-Zn-O（IZO）薄膜，作为透明导电铜扩散阻挡层，用于太阳能电池中替代银电极的铜接触。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非晶In-Zn-O薄膜在Zn/(In+Zn)比例约为0.12且氧含量适中时，可作为有效的透明导电铜扩散阻挡层，在200°C下持续20小时未检测到铜渗透，而硅/铜直接接触在不到1小时内即出现光致发光强度下降。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非晶In-Zn-O薄膜在Zn/(In+Zn)比例约为0.12且氧含量适中时，可作为有效的透明导电铜扩散阻挡层，在200°C下持续20小时未检测到铜渗透，而硅/铜直接接触在不到1小时内即出现光致发光强度下降。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用二维组合方法，通过磁控溅射（无基底加热）制备单一材料库，同时筛选Zn/(In+Zn)比例和氧含量。在硅片上沉积7 nm超薄IZO薄膜，再在其上沉积铜，并在200-450°C退火。通过监测硅化铜形成和硅光致发光信号评估铜扩散阻挡性能。

papers.title: Eigenstate Transitions, Duality, and Anomalous Diffusion in a Quasiperiodic Qi-Wu-Zhang Chern Insulator
papers.abstract: Quasiperiodic systems usually interpolate between extended, critical, and localized states as the quasiperiodic modulation is increased. Here we show that the magnetic Qi-Wu-Zhang Chern-insulator model realizes a distinct full-spectrum transition in which localization is avoided. For an irrational magnetic flux, the two-dimensional model reduces to a spinor quasiperiodic chain with a matrix onsite modulation controlled by the hopping amplitude $t_x$. When $|m+2|>t_y$, increasing $t_x$ produces the conventional extended-critical-localized sequence with a critical line at $t_x=t_y$. In contrast, when $|m+2|\le t_y$, the system changes from an extended phase to a critical phase at $t_x=|m+2|$ and remains critical even for stronger quasiperiodic modulation. Finite-size scaling of the average inverse participation ratio gives $\overline{\mathrm{IPR}}\sim q^{-α}$ with $0<α<1$ throughout this persistent critical regime. A dual transformation exchanging $t_x$ and $t_y$, together with a Lyapunov-exponent analysis, explains the phase diagram. Wave-packet dynamics further distinguish ballistic, anomalous-diffusive, and localized regimes. These results identify magnetic Chern-insulator systems as a natural platform for robust criticality and anomalous quantum transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：模型分析、相图推导、Lyapunov指数分析、波包动力学模拟）；研究对象：准周期调制下的磁性Qi-Wu-Zhang陈绝缘体模型，具体研究其本征态相变、对偶性及反常扩散行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在特定参数区间（|m+2|≤t_y），系统随准周期调制增强不会进入局域化相，而是保持临界相，且平均逆参与率呈现幂律标度行为（IPR~q^{-α}，0<α<1），实现了一种避免局域化的全谱相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在特定参数区间（|m+2|≤t_y），系统随准周期调制增强不会进入局域化相，而是保持临界相，且平均逆参与率呈现幂律标度行为（IPR~q^{-α}，0<α<1），实现了一种避免局域化的全谱相变。；创新点：揭示了磁性陈绝缘体体系作为实现鲁棒临界性和反常量子输运的自然平台，发现了准周期系统中避免局域化的新型全谱相变机制，并建立了对偶变换与Lyapunov指数分析相结合的相图解释框架。
papers.method_zh: 通过将二维陈绝缘体模型约化为一维自旋准周期链（矩阵在位调制），利用有限尺寸标度分析平均逆参与率，结合对偶变换（交换t_x与t_y）与Lyapunov指数分析解释相图，并通过波包动力学区分弹道、反常扩散和局域化输运行为。

papers.title: Topological zero-reflection points in multi-terminal quantum wire junctions
papers.abstract: We study scattering in noninteracting multi-terminal quantum wire junctions and show that junctions with dihedral symmetry can exhibit exact zero-reflection points for $N \ge 4$ terminals. By analyzing the scattering matrix, we identify these reflectionless points in the $(E,t')$ parameter space, where $E$ is the incident particle energy and $t'$ is the junction hopping amplitude. These points exhibit an even-odd dependence on $N$ and converge asymptotically to a common limiting value in the large-$N$ limit. We show that the reflectionless points are characterized by an integer winding number associated with the phase of the reflection amplitude, providing a topological description for their stability against weak on-site disorder. We also consider junctions with broken time-reversal symmetry and find that a magnetic flux can induce additional reflectionless points, including for the $N = 3$ case. For a four-terminal junction threaded by a $π$-flux, we identify a unique parameter regime in which the reflection amplitude vanishes over the entire energy band. Finally, we discuss experimental signatures through the behavior of Friedel oscillations and examine the stability of these reflectionless points in the presence of weak interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We study scattering”“By analyzing the scattering matrix”“We show that”等理论分析表述，未提及实验或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：多端量子线结（multi-terminal quantum wire junctions），具体研究具有二面体对称性的非相互作用多端结中的零反射点现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于终端数 N ≥ 4 且具有二面体对称性的结，在能量-跳跃振幅参数空间中存在精确的零反射点；这些点由反射振幅相位的整数绕数表征，具有拓扑稳定性；在时间反演对称性破缺时，磁通可诱导额外的零反射点，包括 N=3 的情况；对于通有 π 磁通的四端结，存在反射振幅在整个能带内消失的独特参数区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于终端数 N ≥ 4 且具有二面体对称性的结，在能量-跳跃振幅参数空间中存在精确的零反射点；这些点由反射振幅相位的整数绕数表征，具有拓扑稳定性；在时间反演对称性破缺时，磁通可诱导额外的零反射点，包括 N=3 的情况；对于通有 π 磁通的四端结，存在反射振幅在整个能带内消失的独特参数区域。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但明确指出发现了多端结中零反射点的拓扑起源（整数绕数）及其对二面体对称性的依赖，以及磁通诱导的额外零反射点（包括 N=3 情况）和全能带零反射的特殊参数区域。
papers.method_zh: 散射矩阵分析（scattering matrix analysis），结合绕数（winding number）的拓扑描述，并讨论弱无序和弱相互作用下的稳定性。

papers.title: High-harmonic spin-current signatures of altermagnetic spin-group symmetry
papers.abstract: Spin point groups classify magnetic phases in the weak spin-orbit coupling regime and characterize the static properties of altermagnetic phases, but their dynamical consequences remain largely unexplored. Here, we derive selection rules for high-harmonic generation of charge and spin currents by extending dynamical symmetry to include spin point group operations. Since spin currents transform under both real and spin space operations, whereas charge currents transform only under real space operations, spin current selection rules can reveal magnetic information that is inaccessible to charge current harmonics. In a minimal altermagnetic model, an axis-aligned linearly polarized drive is non-diagnostic for distinguishing ferromagnetic and altermagnetic phases, although the antiferromagnetic phase is distinguished by the absence of the corresponding spin-current harmonics. A diagonal linearly polarized drive distinguishes the three SPG phases within the weak-SOC spin-group description, whereas a single-helicity circularly polarized drive provides a sharper spin-current-harmonic criterion for distinguishing them from magnetic-point-group mimics. These results establish spin current harmonics as a dynamical probe of spin group symmetry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“推导选择定则”、“建立动力学对称性”、“在最小模型中进行理论分析”等关键词。；研究对象：交变磁相（altermagnetic phases）中高次谐波产生的自旋电流，以及自旋点群对称性对其的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋电流的高次谐波选择定则能够揭示电荷电流谐波无法获取的磁对称性信息，从而区分交变磁相与铁磁、反铁磁相，尤其是在弱自旋-轨道耦合框架下。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋电流的高次谐波选择定则能够揭示电荷电流谐波无法获取的磁对称性信息，从而区分交变磁相与铁磁、反铁磁相，尤其是在弱自旋-轨道耦合框架下。；创新点：首次将自旋点群对称性引入高次谐波产生的动力学分析，并证明自旋电流谐波可作为区分交变磁相与磁性点群相似相（magnetic-point-group mimics）的动态探针。
papers.method_zh: 通过将动力学对称性扩展至包含自旋点群操作，推导出电荷电流与自旋电流高次谐波产生的选择定则；并在一个最小交变磁模型中进行理论分析，比较不同偏振驱动（轴向线性偏振、对角线性偏振、单螺旋圆偏振）下的谐波响应。

papers.title: Electronic theory for scanning tunneling microscopy spectra in bilayer nickelate thin films
papers.abstract: Recent Scanning Tunneling Microscopy (STM) experiments measuring the superconducting gap features in thin films of superconducting bilayer nickelates La2PrNi2O7 at ambient pressure and compressive strain paved the way to study the Cooper-pairing models and the band-selective identification of the gap features in these systems. Here, using the realistic two-orbital bilayer model and the continuum Green's function formalism, we theoretically analyze orbital and band-selective local density of states as well as the corresponding STM spectra. We find that the multiorbital character and the spatial dependence of the Wannier functions leads to the spectra developing characteristic features depending on the position of the scanning tunneling microscope's tip. This allows for a band-resolved analysis of the superconducting coherence peaks and scattering momenta. We identify a clear path for experimental measurements to not only identify the debated incipiency of the gamma-band, but also identification of the coherence peaks' band origins via distance dependent measurements of the local density of states and its corrections through impurity scattering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“theoretically analyze”、“continuum Green's function formalism”。；研究对象：超导双层镍氧化物薄膜La₂PrNi₂O₇中的扫描隧道显微镜（STM）谱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Wannier函数的多轨道特性及其空间依赖性导致STM谱随针尖位置变化而呈现特征性特征，从而可以实现对超导相干峰和散射动量的能带分辨分析。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Wannier函数的多轨道特性及其空间依赖性导致STM谱随针尖位置变化而呈现特征性特征，从而可以实现对超导相干峰和散射动量的能带分辨分析。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用双轨道双层模型和连续格林函数形式论，理论分析了轨道和能带分辨的局域态密度（LDOS）及对应的STM谱。

papers.title: Spin-related transport in a polycrystalline NiCo2O4 film: Drastic current-induced change in resistivity-temperature characteristics via spin injection
papers.abstract: We have studied spin-related transport in a polycrystalline NiCo2O4 (NCO) film on a MgAl2O4/Si(001) substrate, motivated by potential applications of the theoretical half-metallicity of NCO to Si-based high-performance spin-transport devices. Our approach is to systematically measure and analyze the temperature dependence of the film's resistivity ($ρ-T$) with various in-plane currents (100 nA$-$1 mA) and temperatures (4$-$290 K). With increasing current, the $ρ-T$ curve changes drastically from semiconducting ($dρ/dT<0$) to non-monotonic and eventually toward metallic ($dρ/dT>0$). A distinctive feature is that the single NCO film exhibits a $ρ-T$ characteristic of polycrystalline defective NCO at 100 nA, whereas it exhibits a $ρ-T$ characteristic of epitaxial less-defective NCO over a wide temperature range at 1 mA. This current-induced evolution of $ρ-T$ reflects the enhancement of the Curie temperature of defective regions near grain boundaries, accompanied by enhanced spin alignment there. We proposed a spin-related transport model that extends conventional hopping conduction models by incorporating the temperature- and current-dependent degree of spin alignment, as well as its spatial dependence inherent to polycrystalline NCO. This model comprehensively explains the interplay between the spin-alignment profile and transport mechanism. The analysis reveals that spin injection from grain bodies to grain boundaries enhances the spin alignment there and strengthens double-exchange interactions, facilitating conduction. This phenomenon strongly depends on both temperature and current. Our findings provide evidence of spin-polarized electrons inside the grain bodies, highlighting the potential of our polycrystalline NCO film as an efficient spin source. The present model is further supported by current$-$voltage and magnetoresistance features.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：measured、analyze、current-induced evolution、transport model。；研究对象：多晶NiCo2O4（NCO）薄膜及其自旋相关输运现象，具体研究电流和温度对电阻率-温度特性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过改变注入电流，多晶NCO薄膜的电阻率-温度特性可从半导体型（dρ/dT<0）转变为非单调型，最终趋向金属型（dρ/dT>0），这一演化反映了晶界附近缺陷区域居里温度的提升和自旋排列的增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过改变注入电流，多晶NCO薄膜的电阻率-温度特性可从半导体型（dρ/dT<0）转变为非单调型，最终趋向金属型（dρ/dT>0），这一演化反映了晶界附近缺陷区域居里温度的提升和自旋排列的增强。；创新点：首次在多晶NCO单层薄膜中观察到电流诱导的电阻率-温度特性从半导体到金属的剧烈转变，并建立了包含自旋排列空间不均匀性的输运模型，揭示了从晶粒体到晶界的自旋注入增强双交换作用从而促进导电的机制。
papers.method_zh: 系统测量了不同面内电流（100 nA–1 mA）和温度（4–290 K）下的电阻率-温度曲线，并结合电流-电压特性和磁电阻特征进行分析；提出了一个扩展的跳跃传导模型，引入温度、电流依赖的自旋排列程度及其空间分布。

papers.title: Design Principles for Quasi-Isotropic Exchange in Rare-Earth Quantum Magnets
papers.abstract: Rare-earth quantum materials provide a promising platform for emergent phenomena ranging from quantum spin liquids with long-range entanglement to topological magnetic textures. However, the strong spin-orbit coupling that stabilizes their low-energy pseudospin degrees of freedom also tends to generate strongly anisotropic exchange interactions, complicating the realization of quasi-isotropic Heisenberg magnetism. Here we investigate the microscopic origin of superexchange in $\mathrm{Ce}^{3+}$- and $\mathrm{Yb}^{3+}$-based insulators with edge-sharing octahedral geometry. Using degenerate perturbation theory for a multiorbital Hubbard model, we show that isotropic exchange originates predominantly from virtual hopping within the ground-state Kramers doublet, whereas anisotropic interactions arise primarily from processes involving excited multiplets. This leads to a simple orbital design principle: quasi-isotropic exchange is promoted when the ground-state doublet has a strong maximal-angular-momentum character with respect to the quantization axis perpendicular to the superexchange plane spanned by rare-earth and ligand ions. We demonstrate this mechanism for both ideal and distorted geometries and show that it is broadly consistent with experimentally studied Yb-based insulators. Our results establish a practical framework for engineering quasi-isotropic interactions in rare-earth quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用退化微扰论、多轨道Hubbard模型等理论框架进行分析，未涉及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：稀土量子磁体中准各向同性交换相互作用的微观起源与设计原理，具体聚焦于Ce³⁺和Yb³⁺基绝缘体（边共享八面体几何结构）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 准各向同性交换主要来源于基态Kramers二重态内的虚跃迁，而各向异性相互作用主要来自涉及激发多重态的过程；当基态二重态相对于垂直于超交换平面的量子化轴具有强最大角动量特征时，可促进准各向同性交换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：准各向同性交换主要来源于基态Kramers二重态内的虚跃迁，而各向异性相互作用主要来自涉及激发多重态的过程；当基态二重态相对于垂直于超交换平面的量子化轴具有强最大角动量特征时，可促进准各向同性交换。；创新点：提出了一个简单的轨道设计原理：通过调控基态二重态的角动量特征（垂直于超交换平面方向）来工程化准各向同性交换相互作用，为稀土量子材料中实现近各向同性海森堡磁性提供了实用框架。
papers.method_zh: 基于多轨道Hubbard模型的退化微扰论，分析超交换相互作用的微观起源；对理想和畸变几何结构进行机制演示，并与实验已知的Yb基绝缘体进行一致性比较。

papers.title: Self-propulsion of a polaron with an oscillating coupling to its quantum bath
papers.abstract: Motivated by the quest for active quantum matter, we investigate the dynamics of an impurity immersed in a quantum gas -- a polaron -- whose coupling to the surrounding medium is periodically modulated in time, alternating in sign. By integrating out the bath degrees of freedom, we derive an effective velocity-dependent drag force acting on the impurity. Above a critical modulation frequency, the corresponding drag coefficient becomes negative at low velocities, signaling the onset of self-propulsion. In the classical limit, we characterize this transition as a function of the modulation frequency and the bath chemical potential. We then compute the leading-order quantum corrections to the impurity dynamics and show that, while the transition remains robust, it can be suppressed by sufficiently precise measurements of the impurity position.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：derive an effective velocity-dependent drag force、compute the leading-order quantum corrections、classical limit。；研究对象：极化子（polaron）——一个浸入量子气体中的杂质，其与周围介质的耦合强度随时间周期性调制（交替变号），研究其自推进（self-propulsion）动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当调制频率超过临界值时，极化子在低速下受到的拖曳系数变为负值，从而触发自推进运动；该自推进转变在经典极限下依赖于调制频率和浴化学势，且量子修正虽使转变保持稳健，但足够精确的杂质位置测量可抑制该转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当调制频率超过临界值时，极化子在低速下受到的拖曳系数变为负值，从而触发自推进运动；该自推进转变在经典极限下依赖于调制频率和浴化学势，且量子修正虽使转变保持稳健，但足够精确的杂质位置测量可抑制该转变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过积分掉浴自由度，推导出作用于杂质上的有效速度依赖拖曳力；在经典极限下分析转变随调制频率和浴化学势的变化；进一步计算杂质动力学的领头阶量子修正。

papers.title: Floquet Majorana flat bands and emergent Cooper pair symmetries in $p-$wave magnet$-$superconductor heterostructure
papers.abstract: We investigate the emergence of topological superconductivity at the two-dimensional heterostructure interface between a $p$-wave magnet (pWM) and an $s$-wave superconductor. By analyzing nodal gap closings, we identify seven distinct nodal topological phases, each characterized by the presence of Majorana zero-energy flat bands and quantized zero-bias conductance peaks. We demonstrate that the effective $p$-wave nature of the system gives rise to spin-triplet pairing correlations with even-frequency, odd-parity and odd-frequency, even-parity symmetries. Notably, the introduction of inter-orbital hopping induces an exotic orbital-singlet term characterized by simultaneous odd-parity and odd-frequency. Furthermore, we explore the transition from static phases to Floquet topological regimes through periodic driving. These driven phases host both zero and $π$ Majorana flat bands, with transport signatures governed by the Floquet sum rule. Most significantly, we show that periodic driving fundamentally reshapes the topological and superconducting landscape by generating multiple nodal points that support higher winding numbers and multiple Majorana flat bands, while the emergent Floquet degree of freedom doubles the number of symmetry-allowed Cooper-pair correlations. The first class of correlations is hosted by the even-Floquet sectors and has a direct counterpart in the static limit. In contrast, the second is a distinct Floquet-generated class that confines to the odd-Floquet sectors, representing a fundamentally nonequilibrium pairing channel that cannot exist in static systems. Finally, we demonstrate the robustness of these topological modes against strong disorder, confirming their potential for stable fault-tolerant applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We investigate”“We demonstrate”“We explore”等理论分析表述，未提及实验手段或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：p波磁体与s波超导体构成的二维异质结界面，研究其拓扑超导性、马约拉纳零能平带、Floquet拓扑相以及库珀对对称性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 周期性驱动（Floquet工程）可在该异质结中产生零能及π能马约拉纳平带，并诱导出静态系统中不存在的奇Floquet扇区配对通道，同时通过产生多个节点点实现更高绕数和多重马约拉纳平带。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：周期性驱动（Floquet工程）可在该异质结中产生零能及π能马约拉纳平带，并诱导出静态系统中不存在的奇Floquet扇区配对通道，同时通过产生多个节点点实现更高绕数和多重马约拉纳平带。；创新点：首次在p波磁体-超导体异质结中引入Floquet驱动，揭示了由驱动产生的奇Floquet扇区所独有的非平衡配对通道，该通道在静态系统中不存在；同时发现驱动可倍增对称性允许的库珀对关联种类。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过节点能隙闭合分析识别拓扑相；利用Floquet理论处理周期性驱动；基于对称性分析分类库珀对关联（偶频奇宇称、奇频偶宇称等）；通过Floquet求和规则分析输运特征；并检验了拓扑模式对强无序的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Growth optimization of shallow Ge quantum wells grown by molecular beam epitaxy
papers.abstract: Shallow strained Ge quantum wells have gained recent attention for realizing scalable, high-performance hybrid superconductor/semiconductor-based qubits. Epitaxial superconducting contacts can improve the quality and consistency of the superconductor/semiconductor interface. The growth of Ge quantum wells by molecular beam epitaxy is then motivating due to the relative ease of integration with epitaxial superconductor growth. However, the performance of Ge quantum wells grown by molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) has been limited. To improve the properties of MBE-grown Ge quantum wells, the growth conditions were systematically optimized. Thick buffer layers are utilized to eliminate certain defects, and an optimal growth temperature is found. A peak hole mobility of 105,000 cm\textsuperscript{2}/Vs at 2 K is obtained in a 22-nm deep Ge quantum well, demonstrating that the Ge quantum wells grown in this study represent the highest mobilities for shallow MBE-grown samples. Mobility modeling indicates that the increase in mobility due to growth temperature optimization are likely due to a reduction in interface roughness scattering, and further improvements in mobility are expected through improved surface passivation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：molecular beam epitaxy（分子束外延）、growth optimization（生长优化）、mobility measurement（迁移率测量）。；研究对象：浅层应变锗量子阱（shallow strained Ge quantum wells），用于超导/半导体混合量子比特。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过系统优化分子束外延生长条件，在22纳米深的锗量子阱中获得了105,000 cm²/Vs（2 K）的空穴迁移率，这是目前浅层MBE生长样品中的最高值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过系统优化分子束外延生长条件，在22纳米深的锗量子阱中获得了105,000 cm²/Vs（2 K）的空穴迁移率，这是目前浅层MBE生长样品中的最高值。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长技术，结合厚缓冲层消除缺陷、优化生长温度，并通过迁移率建模分析散射机制。

papers.title: Geometrically necessary boundaries accommodate the residual elastic strain in cold-rolled Fe-3%Si
papers.abstract: The relationship between plastic deformation accommodation structures and residual elastic strain fields in deformed metals is poorly understood at the intragranular scale, largely because no experimental technique has provided simultaneous, three-dimensional, bulk-sensitive access to both fields at the length scale of dislocation boundaries. Here we use dark-field X-ray microscopy (DFXM) to map intragranular misorientation and residual elastic strain simultaneously in three dimensions within a grain of 50% cold-rolled Fe 3%Si alloy. We resolve geometrically necessary boundaries (GNBs) and incidental dislocation boundary (IDB) cell structures in the bulk non-destructively. Correlating the elastic strain field with the segmented plastically deformed substructure reveals that GNBs act as the primary carriers and distributors of long range residual elastic strain. GNBs separate subdomains of distinct mean d-spacing, across the grain volume. The plastic misorientation associated with IDBs and dislocation cells develops within GNB-delimited subdomains that carry comparatively similar values of elastic strain. This supports a mechanistic picture in which GNBs accommodate nearly all the long-range residual elastic strain in the deformed state, while plastic slip propagates into GNB interiors to organize into IDB cells with similar strain levels. The three-dimensional misorientation and strain gradients quantified here provide direct experimental input for recovery and recrystallization modelling in ferritic steels, such as electrical steels.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述了使用暗场X射线显微镜（DFXM）进行三维实验测量。；研究对象：50%冷轧Fe-3%Si合金（一种电工钢）中变形晶粒内的位错结构与残余弹性应变场。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 几何必要边界（GNBs）是变形金属中长程残余弹性应变的主要载体和分布者，而偶然位错边界（IDBs）和位错胞结构则发育在具有相似弹性应变水平的GNB限定子域内。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：几何必要边界（GNBs）是变形金属中长程残余弹性应变的主要载体和分布者，而偶然位错边界（IDBs）和位错胞结构则发育在具有相似弹性应变水平的GNB限定子域内。；创新点：首次在块体材料内部、位错边界尺度上，同时、三维地获得了塑性变形容纳结构与残余弹性应变场之间的直接关联，揭示了GNBs在容纳长程残余弹性应变中的主导作用。
papers.method_zh: 暗场X射线显微镜（DFXM），用于同时、三维、无损地测量块体材料晶粒内部的取向差和残余弹性应变场。

papers.title: Tuning topological phase and Dirac point position via Pb and Sb substitution in Mn$_{1-x}$Pb$_{x}$(Bi$_{1-y}$Sb$_{y}$)$_{2}$Te$_{4}$
papers.abstract: This study presents a systematic investigation of Mn$_{1-x}$Pb$_{x}$(Bi$_{1-y}$Sb$_{y}$)$_{2}$Te$_{4}$ crystals over a wide range of concentrations (x = 10-60%, y = 5-60%). It was found that the value of the bulk band gap is determined exclusively by the Pb concentration and it closes at Pb 40-50 %, which corresponds to a topological phase transition. The position of the Dirac point is determined by the Pb/Sb ratio, rather than the absolute Sb content. The magnetic properties depend on the dilution of the Mn sublattice by Pb and are weakly sensitive to Sb. We show that the simultaneous substitution of Mn and Bi allows independent control of the topological phase and the position of the Fermi level.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“systematic investigation”、“crystals”、“found that”、“show that”表明为实验研究。；研究对象：拓扑材料体系 Mn₁₋ₓPbₓ(Bi₁₋ᵧSbᵧ)₂Te₄，具体研究通过 Pb 和 Sb 替代调控其拓扑相、狄拉克点位置及磁性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 体带隙大小仅由 Pb 浓度决定，在 Pb 含量 40-50% 时带隙闭合，对应拓扑相变；狄拉克点位置由 Pb/Sb 比例而非绝对 Sb 含量决定；同时替代 Mn 和 Bi 可独立调控拓扑相和费米能级位置。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：体带隙大小仅由 Pb 浓度决定，在 Pb 含量 40-50% 时带隙闭合，对应拓扑相变；狄拉克点位置由 Pb/Sb 比例而非绝对 Sb 含量决定；同时替代 Mn 和 Bi 可独立调控拓扑相和费米能级位置。；创新点：实现了通过 Pb 和 Sb 同时替代独立控制拓扑相和费米能级位置，并发现狄拉克点位置由 Pb/Sb 比例而非绝对 Sb 含量决定。
papers.method_zh: 系统生长不同浓度（x=10-60%，y=5-60%）的 Mn₁₋ₓPbₓ(Bi₁₋ᵧSbᵧ)₂Te₄ 单晶，通过测量体带隙、狄拉克点位置及磁性质，分析替代元素对拓扑相和电子结构的影响。摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如 ARPES、输运测量等）。

papers.title: Side-Chain Tuning of Thermal-Expansion Crossover in Metal-Organic Frameworks
papers.abstract: Achieving continuous control over macroscopic thermal expansion remains a fundamental challenge in solid-state physics. Using classical and path-integral molecular dynamics alongside lattice dynamics at near-\emph{ab initio} accuracy, we report an entropy-driven thermal-expansion crossover from positive (PTE) to negative thermal expansion (NTE) in alkoxy-functionalized MOF-5, an archetypal metal-organic framework (MOF). We demonstrate that this non-linear response is continuously tunable via the alkoxy side-chain length, quantified by the number of carbon atoms $n$ grafted onto the archetypal cubic MOF-5 framework: systems with short chains ($n \le 2$) exhibit monotonic NTE, whereas longer chains ($n \ge 3$) trigger a pronounced PTE-to-NTE crossover. At low temperatures, thermal activation of longer side chains opens additional conformational states and generates steric pressure inside the pore, driving positive expansion through a gain in side-chain conformational entropy. Conversely, at elevated temperatures, the side chains enhance transverse linker fluctuations and strengthen the string-tension mechanism associated with low-frequency framework modes, causing structural contraction favored by framework vibrational entropy. Finally, by varying the concentration of side-chain-functionalized linkers, the thermal expansion coefficient can be continuously regulated to realize negative, near-zero, and positive thermal expansion within selected temperature windows. These results establish side-chain engineering as a practical route for programming macroscopic thermodynamic responses in MOFs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用了经典和路径积分分子动力学、晶格动力学等计算方法，且强调“近从头算精度”。；研究对象：侧链功能化的MOF-5（一种原型金属有机框架材料）中的热膨胀行为，特别是从正热膨胀到负热膨胀的交叉现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过改变烷氧基侧链的长度（碳原子数n），可以连续调控MOF-5的热膨胀行为：短链（n≤2）体系呈现单调负热膨胀，长链（n≥3）体系则出现明显的正热膨胀到负热膨胀的交叉。侧链的构象熵和框架振动熵在不同温度下的竞争驱动了这一现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过改变烷氧基侧链的长度（碳原子数n），可以连续调控MOF-5的热膨胀行为：短链（n≤2）体系呈现单调负热膨胀，长链（n≥3）体系则出现明显的正热膨胀到负热膨胀的交叉。侧链的构象熵和框架振动熵在不同温度下的竞争驱动了这一现象。；创新点：首次提出并验证了通过侧链工程（side-chain engineering）连续调控金属有机框架材料宏观热膨胀响应的实用路径，实现了在特定温度窗口内对负、近零和正热膨胀的连续调节。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 经典分子动力学、路径积分分子动力学以及晶格动力学计算，所有方法均达到近从头算精度。

papers.title: Hodge Topology of Semiclassical Transport: A Coordinate-Free Geometric Framework for the Anomalous Hall Effect and Non-Linear Berry Dipole
papers.abstract: We establish a coordinate-free differential geometric framework for anomalous transport in topological bands using the Hodge-de Rham decomposition of the Brillouin zone. Standard formulations face mathematical singularities (Dirac strings) when using the quantum Berry connection in bands with non-zero Chern numbers. Applying this decomposition to the Berry curvature 2-form isolates the quantized topological monopole flux from a globally smooth geometric 1-form proxy potential, $\mathcal{A}$. Substituting this regularized potential into semiclassical transport integrals yields distinct analytical advantages. For linear transverse transport, our cohomological decomposition enables an exact geometric derivation of Haldane's insight via the co-area formula, partitioning the response into a continuous Fermi sea topological background and a localized Fermi surface geometric line integral. For non-linear transport, this globally smooth proxy unifies the geometric description, reproducing the high numerical stability of scalar integration-by-parts techniques directly from its exact sector, accommodating arbitrary Chern numbers. By enforcing the continuous Coulomb-Hodge gauge ($δ\mathcal{A} = 0$) alongside vanishing harmonic holonomies over fundamental 1-cycles ($\oint_{γ_i} \mathcal{A} = 0$), we map the Hodge potential $\mathcal{A}$ to the Maximally Localized Wannier Function (MLWF) gauge in trivial bands, providing a non-singular computational proxy for topologically obstructed bands. Finally, we analytically demonstrate that solving the Hodge Laplacian for $\mathcal{A}$ zeroes the macroscopic Brillouin zone average (uniform $\mathbf{R}=0$ zero-mode) topological divergence, yielding a mathematically consistent covariant formulation that matches the algorithmic robustness of standard methods against discrete $\mathbf{k}$-grid noise.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：coordinate-free differential geometric framework、Hodge-de Rham decomposition、semiclassical transport integrals、analytical demonstration。；研究对象：拓扑能带中的反常输运现象，具体包括反常霍尔效应（Anomalous Hall Effect）和非线性贝里偶极子（Non-Linear Berry Dipole）的几何描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过布里渊区的Hodge-de Rham分解，将贝里曲率2-形式分解为量子化的拓扑磁单极通量与全局光滑的几何1-形式代理势$\mathcal{A}$，从而消除了标准形式中因非零陈数导致的数学奇异性（狄拉克弦），并统一了线性与非线性半经典输运的几何描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过布里渊区的Hodge-de Rham分解，将贝里曲率2-形式分解为量子化的拓扑磁单极通量与全局光滑的几何1-形式代理势$\mathcal{A}$，从而消除了标准形式中因非零陈数导致的数学奇异性（狄拉克弦），并统一了线性与非线性半经典输运的几何描述。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用坐标无关的微分几何框架，具体包括：Hodge-de Rham分解、Coulomb-Hodge规范（$\delta\mathcal{A}=0$）、基本1-循环上的调和全纯消失条件（$\oint_{\gamma_i} \mathcal{A}=0$）、Hodge拉普拉斯方程求解、以及共面积公式（co-area formula）的几何推导。

papers.title: Deviations beyond the Kibble-Zurek mechanism in a Spin-Orbit-Coupled Bose-Einstein Condensate with phenomenological damping
papers.abstract: We investigate the quench dynamics in a one-dimensional spin-orbit-coupled Bose-Einstein condensate (SOC-BEC) across the phase transition from plane-wave (PW) to stripe (ST), incorporating phenomenological damping. In the dissipation-free case, a state stagnation phenomenon emerges during the PW-ST quench: for slow quenches, the system remains trapped in the PW phase due to the energy gap induced by critical slowing down, which prevents spontaneous relaxation to the stripe ground state. To explore this phenomenon and examine the universal scaling predicted by the Kibble-Zurek mechanism (KZM) in open systems, we introduce a dissipative Gross-Pitaevskii equation with a phenomenological damping term. Numerical simulations reveal that weak dissipation preserves the expected KZM power-law scaling for the freeze-out time and defect density, whereas strong dissipation or long quench times lead to significant deviations. Our results demonstrate that the KZM remains applicable in dissipative quantum systems under appropriate conditions, providing insights into nonequilibrium dynamics in open quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：数值模拟、Gross-Pitaevskii方程、Kibble-Zurek机制。；研究对象：一维自旋-轨道耦合玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（SOC-BEC）从平面波相（PW）到条纹相（ST）的量子淬火动力学，并引入唯象阻尼。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无耗散情况下，慢淬火会导致系统因临界慢化产生的能隙而停滞在平面波相；引入弱耗散后，系统仍遵循Kibble-Zurek机制（KZM）的幂律标度，但强耗散或长淬火时间会导致显著偏离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无耗散情况下，慢淬火会导致系统因临界慢化产生的能隙而停滞在平面波相；引入弱耗散后，系统仍遵循Kibble-Zurek机制（KZM）的幂律标度，但强耗散或长淬火时间会导致显著偏离。；创新点：首次在自旋-轨道耦合BEC的PW-ST相变淬火中系统研究了耗散强度对KZM标度律的影响，揭示了强耗散导致偏离的临界条件。
papers.method_zh: 采用含唯象阻尼项的耗散Gross-Pitaevskii方程进行数值模拟，通过分析冻结时间与缺陷密度的标度行为检验KZM的普适性。

papers.title: From Materials Database to Materials Bank: Assetizing Data for AI Driven Materials Innovation
papers.abstract: Driven by high-throughput experimentation, computational modeling, and artificial intelligence (AI), materials data has expanded at an unprecedented rate. Conventional materials databases function only as passive repositories, archiving raw experimental records indiscriminately including both successful and failed data, without systematic value filtering or asset management.
