papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：无序通过AC斯塔克效应将腔模与连续费米子密度模式耦合，重新归一化有效光-物质耦合强度，平均而言降低超辐射阈值，并使阈值在短散斑关联长度下自平均；在阈值之上，无序会扭曲密度波晶体，填充除干净腔几何所选择之外的傅里叶分量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 线性响应理论（推导超辐射阈值）、数值平均场处理（计算腔内光子数和实空间费米子密度）。

papers.title: Unconventional superconductivity in $A$V$_2X_2$O family of surface altermagnets
papers.abstract: Motivated by the recent discovery of superconductivity at 16.3 K in layered oxychalcogenide Na$_{2-x}$V$_2$Se$_2$O we investigate pairing instabilities in the broader family of layered materials composed of V$_2$O planes, believed to exhibit altermagnetic order in their monolayer form. Even though the bulk family members KV$_2$Se$_2$O and Rb$_{1-δ}$V$_{2}$Te$_{2}$O are likely conventional antiferromagnets that show only surface altermagnetism, our analysis predicts exotic equal-spin triplet superconductivity as the dominant pairing instability in these materials. This is a consequence of their unique magnetic and sublattice structure that renders electron bands incompatible with conventional spin-singlet pairing. The predicted triplet superconducting phases are topologically non-trivial and capable of supporting spin-polarized persistent currents, properties potentially useful in technological applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“investigate pairing instabilities”、“our analysis predicts”、“theoretically non-trivial”。；研究对象：层状氧硫族化合物家族 \( A \)V\(_2\)X\(_2\)O（如 Na\(_{2-x}\)V\(_2\)Se\(_2\)O、KV\(_2\)Se\(_2\)O、Rb\(_{1-\delta}\)V\(_2\)Te\(_2\)O）中的非常规超导电性，特别是其表面交变磁（altermagnetic）结构导致的配对不稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该材料家族中，尽管体相可能是常规反铁磁体且仅表面表现出交变磁性，但主导的超导配对不稳定性是奇异的等自旋三重态超导，而非传统的自旋单态配对。该三重态超导相具有拓扑非平庸性质，能支持自旋极化的持续电流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该材料家族中，尽管体相可能是常规反铁磁体且仅表面表现出交变磁性，但主导的超导配对不稳定性是奇异的等自旋三重态超导，而非传统的自旋单态配对。该三重态超导相具有拓扑非平庸性质，能支持自旋极化的持续电流。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。基于材料独特的磁性和子晶格结构，分析电子能带与配对对称性之间的兼容性，从而预测主导的配对不稳定性类型。

papers.title: Athermality of generalized Gibbs ensembles
papers.abstract: Integrable quantum systems evolving from non-equilibrium initial states do not thermalize to conventional Gibbs ensembles (GE). Instead, at long times they relax to generalized Gibbs ensembles (GGEs), which incorporate the full set of local and quasi-local conserved quantities. While GGEs have been extensively studied in the literature, a quantitative characterization of how different they are from ordinary GEs is still lacking. In this work, we address this question by employing the concept of athermality, which we define within quantum resource theory as the relative entropy between a given state and the closest thermal state. We compute the athermality for several quantum quenches in paradigmatic integrable models, including the free XY spin chain, the interacting Lieb-Liniger model, the XXZ spin chain, and the harmonic chain. We find that often the athermality becomes anomalously small when the post-quench Hamiltonian is critical in its ground state, despite probing physics at a finite energy density. We also prove that it systematically develops a singularity at criticality, which is inherited from the entropy of the GGE.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：量子资源理论、相对熵、可积模型、量子淬火。；研究对象：可积量子系统在非平衡初态演化后形成的广义吉布斯系综（GGE）与普通吉布斯系综（GE）之间的差异，具体体系包括自由XY自旋链、相互作用Lieb-Liniger模型、XXZ自旋链和谐振子链。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: GGE与最接近的热态之间的相对熵（即“非热性”）在淬火后哈密顿量的基态处于临界点时往往异常小，且该非热性在临界点处系统性地出现奇异性，该奇异性源自GGE的熵。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：GGE与最接近的热态之间的相对熵（即“非热性”）在淬火后哈密顿量的基态处于临界点时往往异常小，且该非热性在临界点处系统性地出现奇异性，该奇异性源自GGE的熵。；创新点：首次对GGE与普通GE之间的差异进行定量表征，揭示了非热性在临界点处的奇异行为及其与GGE熵的关联。
papers.method_zh: 采用量子资源理论中的“非热性”概念，定义为给定态与最接近热态之间的相对熵；通过计算多个可积模型（XY链、Lieb-Liniger模型、XXZ链、谐振子链）在量子淬火后的非热性进行定量分析。

papers.title: Magnetic Bloch Oscillations in Odd-Wave Magnets and the Nonlinear Edelstein Effect
papers.abstract: Bloch oscillations (BOs) are a quantum phenomenon in which electrons subjected to an electric field in a periodic potential exhibit an oscillating current without a net drift. In real conductors, scattering reduces the coherence required for BOs driving the system toward a steady state with a DC current. While previous studies have focused on charge transport, charge carriers also possess spin, raising the question of whether BOs can emerge in magnetic observables. Here, we show that the magnetization of odd-wave magnets can undergo BOs before relaxing to the steady-state Edelstein value, a phenomenon we term $\textit{magnetic}$ BOs. Using analytical and numerical methods, we demonstrate this effect in a minimal one-dimensional model of a p-wave magnet and generalize it to two dimensions. Our analysis further reveals that the Edelstein magnetization is generically nonlinear in the applied electric field. Finally, we argue that magnetic BOs can be detected in materials through higher-harmonic generation in THz sub-cycle lightwave spectroscopy. Magnetic BOs provide a genuine non-equilibrium signature of spin-charge coupling in unconventional magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：analytical and numerical methods, minimal one-dimensional model, generalization to two dimensions）；研究对象：奇波磁体（odd-wave magnets）中的磁布洛赫振荡（magnetic Bloch oscillations）以及非线性Edelstein效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 奇波磁体的磁化强度在弛豫到稳态Edelstein值之前会发生布洛赫振荡，即“磁布洛赫振荡”；Edelstein磁化强度在电场作用下通常是非线性的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：奇波磁体的磁化强度在弛豫到稳态Edelstein值之前会发生布洛赫振荡，即“磁布洛赫振荡”；Edelstein磁化强度在电场作用下通常是非线性的。；创新点：首次提出并论证了磁性可观测量的布洛赫振荡（磁布洛赫振荡），将传统电荷布洛赫振荡的概念拓展至自旋-电荷耦合体系，并揭示了Edelstein磁化强度的非线性特性。
papers.method_zh: 采用解析与数值方法，构建一维p波磁体的最小模型，并推广至二维体系；通过太赫兹亚周期光波谱学中的高次谐波产生来探测该效应。

papers.title: Stationary covariance spectra of discrete-time non-normal random recurrent dynamics
papers.abstract: Principal component analysis is widely used to characterize structure in the dynamics of recurrent neural networks. For stationary noise-driven dynamics, the distribution of variance among the principal components is determined by the spectrum of the stationary covariance matrix. While the spectral properties of this matrix are well-understood for linear networks with normal synaptic weight matrices, our understanding of the stationary covariance spectrum for random non-normal dynamics remains incomplete. In this note, we use a free-probability approach to formally derive a closed functional equation for the moment generating function of the limiting stationary covariance spectrum of discrete-time dynamics with random non-normal Gaussian weights. This characterization allows us to analyze the behavior of tail eigenvalues in the critical regime. In contrast, applying the same approach to the analogous continuous-time dynamics leads to an infinite hierarchy of Schwinger-Dyson equations, rather than a closed scalar equation. We conclude with some comments regarding the relevance of these results to comparisons of models of non-normal dynamics to neural data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：free-probability approach、formal derivation、functional equation、theoretical analysis。；研究对象：离散时间非正态随机循环动力学系统的平稳协方差谱。具体体系为具有随机非正态高斯权重的离散时间线性循环网络。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用自由概率方法，为离散时间非正态随机动力学系统的平稳协方差谱的矩母函数导出了一个封闭的函数方程，并能在临界区域分析尾特征值行为；而连续时间情形下类似方法仅导致无穷级联的Schwinger-Dyson方程，无法得到封闭标量方程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用自由概率方法，为离散时间非正态随机动力学系统的平稳协方差谱的矩母函数导出了一个封闭的函数方程，并能在临界区域分析尾特征值行为；而连续时间情形下类似方法仅导致无穷级联的Schwinger-Dyson方程，无法得到封闭标量方程。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 自由概率方法（free-probability approach），用于形式推导平稳协方差谱的矩母函数所满足的封闭函数方程。

papers.title: Invasion with size-dependent dispersion range
papers.abstract: The coalescing colony model provides a minimal framework for biological invasions with long-range dispersion. In its standard formulation, the dispersion range is assumed independent of the size of the invading population. Here, we relax this assumption and consider size-dependent dispersal: a main colony of linear size $r$ emits secondary colonies at distance $r^μ$, with $0 \leq μ\leq 1$. We derive the generalized dynamical equations for this extended model and map out the growth phase diagram for the leading order contribution. Depending on $μ$, the main colony exhibits distinct regimes: linear expansion, power-law growth, exponential regime and finite-time blow-up. We confront these theoretical predictions with a spatially explicit physical model. While the coalescing colony approach correctly captures the scaling of the perimeter, it fails to predict the scaling of the volume. We trace this discrepancy to an effective breakdown of circular symmetry in the morphology of the main colony. Finally, we quantify temporal evolution of the population fraction residing outside of the main colony. The coalescing colony model predicts its decay to~$0$ like a power-law when~$μ<1$, and a macroscopic amount of the population remains in the secondary colonies at~$μ=1$. Simulations of the physical model reveal a persistent satellite population not captured by the theory at~$μ>μ^*\approx 0.7$. Broadly, our findings highlight how coupling dispersal range to population size fundamentally alters invasion dynamics, with implications for biological invasions, metastatic growth, and urban expansion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算模拟）。判断依据：推导广义动力学方程、构建生长相图、进行空间显式物理模型模拟并与理论对比。；研究对象：具有尺寸依赖扩散范围的生物入侵过程，具体为“聚并菌落模型”中主菌落线性尺寸 \( r \) 决定次级菌落扩散距离 \( r^\mu \) 的入侵动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当扩散范围指数 \( \mu \) 变化时，主菌落呈现线性扩张、幂律增长、指数增长和有限时间爆炸四种不同生长模式；聚并菌落模型能正确预测周长的标度，但无法正确预测体积的标度，原因在于主菌落形态有效破坏了圆对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当扩散范围指数 \( \mu \) 变化时，主菌落呈现线性扩张、幂律增长、指数增长和有限时间爆炸四种不同生长模式；聚并菌落模型能正确预测周长的标度，但无法正确预测体积的标度，原因在于主菌落形态有效破坏了圆对称性。；创新点：首次在聚并菌落模型中引入与种群大小（菌落尺寸）相关的扩散范围，揭示了扩散范围与种群大小耦合如何根本性地改变入侵动力学，并发现当 \( \mu > 0.7 \) 时物理模型中出现理论未捕捉到的持久卫星种群。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：扩展聚并菌落模型，得到广义动力学方程并绘制主导阶生长相图；数值模拟：采用空间显式物理模型验证理论预测，并分析主菌落外种群比例的时间演化。

papers.title: Fate of "Space-like singularities" in $c=1$ Matrix Model
papers.abstract: A class of time dependent backgrounds in two dimensional String Theory leads to superluminal Liouville walls on the worldsheet. In the dual double scaled $c=1$ matrix model these backgrounds involve eigenvalues leaking out to infinity, and the collective field fluctuations become strongly coupled along space-like regions, resembling singularities. We realize these backgrounds as results of quantum quenches in the matrix model, retaining non-linear terms in the matrix potential, thus departing from a double scaling limit. Working in the fermion picture in a Thomas-Fermi approximation, we show that while the early time behavior of the phase space density near the maximum of the potential agrees with that obtained in the double scaled theory, at times of the order $(\log N)$ the effect of the IR wall becomes significant. At later times, with a characteristic winding time of order $(\log N)^2$, folds on the fermi surface proliferate and eventually cover the allowed region in phase space densely. Using action-angle variables, we show that the phase space density oscillates around a time independent and angle independent value rapidly at late times. A coarse-grained density in the angle space relaxes to a time independent equilibrium value as a power law with a universal exponent largely independent of the details of the initial state. Thus, the appearance of a space-like singularity is an artifact of the strict double scaling limit. We comment on the interpretation of the final state in String Theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：双标度极限、Thomas-Fermi近似、作用-角变量、相空间密度分析。；研究对象：二维弦论中依赖于时间的背景（超光速Liouville墙）及其在$c=1$矩阵模型中的对偶描述，具体关注时空类奇点（space-like singularities）的物理命运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在$c=1$矩阵模型中，时空类奇点的出现是严格双标度极限的人为产物；当保留矩阵势的非线性项并考虑有限$N$效应时，费米面折叠在时间尺度$(\log N)^2$内密集覆盖整个允许相空间，相空间密度经粗粒化后以普适幂律弛豫到与时间、角度无关的平衡值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在$c=1$矩阵模型中，时空类奇点的出现是严格双标度极限的人为产物；当保留矩阵势的非线性项并考虑有限$N$效应时，费米面折叠在时间尺度$(\log N)^2$内密集覆盖整个允许相空间，相空间密度经粗粒化后以普适幂律弛豫到与时间、角度无关的平衡值。；创新点：首次在$c=1$矩阵模型中超越双标度极限，通过保留有限$N$效应和势的非线性项，揭示了类奇点结构的非本质性，并给出了晚期平衡态的普适弛豫指数。
papers.method_zh: 采用量子淬火实现背景，在费米子图像下使用Thomas-Fermi近似分析相空间密度演化；引入作用-角变量描述晚期动力学；通过粗粒化角度空间得到弛豫行为。

papers.title: Navigating committor landscape of biomolecules with a general pairwise interaction model
papers.abstract: Sampling rare conformation transitions between metastable states is a central challenge in atomistic simulations. While the committor function serve as an ideal reaction coordinate for driving enhanced sampling, their high-dimensional inputs and complex functional forms limit the efficacy of standard feedforward neural networks in modeling them. Inspired by recent breakthroughs in biomolecular structure prediction, we propose a novel committor learning framework grounded in the AlphaFold 3 paradigm. By integrating a lightweight, differentiable atom-level embedding with a simplified Pairformer architecture, our method inherently captures intricate dynamical features of diverse biosystems without requiring specialized prior knowledge. We demonstrate the superior expressiveness and accuracy of the proposed framework across multiple atomistic processes. For the folding of the chignolin mini-protein, our model reveals the finer-grained structure of its transition state ensemble (TSE) and a detailed bifurcated reaction mechanism. Furthermore, for calixarene host-guest systems, we develop a unified committor model that elucidates how ligand substituents regulate the ratio between distinct binding pathways, offering new perspectives for structure-based drug design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：committor function、enhanced sampling、neural network、AlphaFold 3 paradigm、atomistic simulations。；研究对象：生物分子的稀有构象转变，具体包括：chignolin mini-protein（一种小型蛋白质）的折叠过程，以及calixarene host-guest systems（杯芳烃主客体体系）中的配体结合路径。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于AlphaFold 3范式的committor学习框架，能够更精确地描述生物分子稀有构象转变的过渡态，揭示了chignolin折叠中更精细的过渡态结构（TSE）和分叉反应机制，以及杯芳烃体系中配体取代基如何调控不同结合路径的比例。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于AlphaFold 3范式的committor学习框架，能够更精确地描述生物分子稀有构象转变的过渡态，揭示了chignolin折叠中更精细的过渡态结构（TSE）和分叉反应机制，以及杯芳烃体系中配体取代基如何调控不同结合路径的比例。；创新点：将AlphaFold 3中的Pairformer架构引入committor学习，克服了标准前馈神经网络在处理高维输入和复杂动力学特征时的局限性，实现了对多种生物体系动力学特征的通用、高精度建模。
papers.method_zh: 采用轻量级、可微分的原子级嵌入（atom-level embedding）结合简化的Pairformer架构，构建committor函数模型。该方法无需专门的先验知识，直接对高维输入和复杂函数形式进行学习。

papers.title: Contrastive Regularization of Machine Learning Potentials
papers.abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials are trained to predict energies and forces but built to be sampled: their purpose is to drive molecular simulations whose observables average over the equilibrium distribution the potential defines. They exemplify a broader AI problem -- learned regressors deployed as generators -- where pointwise accuracy does not guarantee a correct distribution. We show that potentials trained by standard Mean Squared Error (MSE) minimization on Density Functional Theory (DFT) data can reach chemical accuracy on held-out data, yet still fail as samplers: their trajectories drift into spurious low-energy minima and return thermodynamic observables that depart sharply from the reference. To correct this, we introduce Contrastive Regularized MSE (CRMSE), a post-training step that augments the MSE with a contrastive term derived from the Kullback--Leibler divergence between the potential's implicit Boltzmann distribution and the target. The network serves as its own energy-based model: persistent Langevin chains expose the configurations it drifts into and raise their energy, adding no new ab initio data. On the ethanol and aspirin molecules of the MD17 dataset, CRMSE confines the sampler to the physical basin and recovers the energy distribution, interatomic-distance distributions, and dihedral free-energy profiles to near-quantitative agreement with DFT, while preserving force accuracy and keeping energy errors within chemical accuracy; it remains effective when the training set is sharply reduced. That MSE training fails this way on MD17 -- one of the most widely used benchmarks -- while a minimal contrastive correction repairs it suggests that reliable sampling depends less on data volume than on training the model against the distribution it produces: distribution-level training is not a refinement of regression accuracy, but a distinct requirement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：machine learning interatomic potentials、Density Functional Theory (DFT) data、molecular simulations、Langevin chains。；研究对象：机器学习力场（Machine Learning Potentials）在分子模拟中的采样行为，具体以MD17数据集中的乙醇（ethanol）和阿司匹林（aspirin）分子为测试体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 标准均方误差（MSE）训练得到的机器学习力场虽能达到化学精度，但在作为采样器进行分子动力学模拟时，会漂移到虚假的低能构型，导致热力学观测值严重偏离参考值；而引入对比正则化（CRMSE）后，无需新增第一性原理数据即可修复采样行为，使模拟结果与DFT定量一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：标准均方误差（MSE）训练得到的机器学习力场虽能达到化学精度，但在作为采样器进行分子动力学模拟时，会漂移到虚假的低能构型，导致热力学观测值严重偏离参考值；而引入对比正则化（CRMSE）后，无需新增第一性原理数据即可修复采样行为，使模拟结果与DFT定量一致。；创新点：揭示了回归精度（点态准确度）与分布正确性（采样可靠性）之间的本质区别，并提出一种无需额外DFT数据的后训练正则化方法，将力场从“回归器”转变为正确的“生成器”。
papers.method_zh: 对比正则化均方误差（Contrastive Regularized MSE, CRMSE）训练方法：在标准MSE损失基础上，增加一个基于Kullback-Leibler散度的对比项，该对比项通过持久化Langevin链采样模型自发漂移到的构型并提升其能量，从而调整势能面的分布。训练数据来自DFT计算，不引入新的ab initio数据。

papers.title: The Invariant Measure of Multiscale Markov Chains via Fast Arborescence Factorization
papers.abstract: We consider a family of continuous-time Markov chains with finite strongly connected transition graph and rates $\left(r_N\right)_{N>0}$ depending on a parameter $N$, so that, when $N$ is large, transitions may happen on different time scales. Under suitable general assumptions on the asymptotic behavior of the rates, we give a recursive characterization of the limiting invariant measure. The recursion is encoded in a forest structure equivalent to the one recently developed in the analysis of dynamical aspects of metastability \cite{BL,LX}. Our proof is based on a combinatorial representation of the invariant measure, given by the Markov chain tree theorem. Basic steps are the reduction of the chain by a trace process, the introduction of an effective dynamics, and a careful analysis of the set of relevant arborescences in the expansion. In particular we use a factorization of fast arborescences. As a byproduct we obtain properties of the arborescences of generalized star-delta reductions of weighted digraphs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：continuous-time Markov chains、recursive characterization、combinatorial representation、theoretical framework。；研究对象：多尺度马尔可夫链（multiscale Markov chains）的平稳测度（invariant measure），具体为一族具有有限强连通转移图且速率依赖于参数 \( N \) 的连续时间马尔可夫链，当 \( N \) 很大时，转移可能发生在不同时间尺度上。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在关于速率渐近行为的适当一般假设下，给出了极限平稳测度的递归刻画，该递归结构等价于近期亚稳态动力学分析中发展的森林结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在关于速率渐近行为的适当一般假设下，给出了极限平稳测度的递归刻画，该递归结构等价于近期亚稳态动力学分析中发展的森林结构。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于马尔可夫链树定理（Markov chain tree theorem）对平稳测度进行组合表示；通过迹过程（trace process）对链进行约化，引入有效动力学（effective dynamics），并对展开式中相关树状结构（arborescences）进行细致分析；特别地，使用了快树状结构的因式分解（factorization of fast arborescences）。

papers.title: Plasmonic-cavity Modulator for the Mid-IR with a Semi-transparent and Nonlinear Heavily-doped Semiconductor Mirror
papers.abstract: We present a free-space plasmonic modulator based on a single heavily-doped semiconductor layer. We investigate its ability to modulate both the linear and nonlinear response at mid-infrared frequencies slightly below the plasma frequency of the semiconductor. We demonstrate electric control of the linear transmittance and reflectance, and of the efficiency of third-harmonic generation with a field-effect gate structure. We discuss further performance optimization of the device in terms of modulation speed and depth towards a fast modulator with very simple active material requirements. Our results establish a viable route toward practical plasmonic modulators and mixers operating in the mid-infrared atmospheric window available for free-space communications at wavelengths between 8 and 12 um.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：demonstrate、electric control、field-effect gate structure、performance optimization）；研究对象：基于单层重掺杂半导体（heavily-doped semiconductor layer）的等离子体-腔调制器，工作于中红外波段（8-12 μm），研究其线性透射/反射调制以及三阶谐波产生的非线性响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过场效应栅极结构，实现了对中红外频率（略低于半导体等离子体频率）的线性透射率、反射率以及三阶谐波产生效率的电学调控，并指出该器件有望实现结构简单、调制速度快的实用化等离子体调制器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过场效应栅极结构，实现了对中红外频率（略低于半导体等离子体频率）的线性透射率、反射率以及三阶谐波产生效率的电学调控，并指出该器件有望实现结构简单、调制速度快的实用化等离子体调制器。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上制备了单层重掺杂半导体薄膜，构建自由空间等离子体调制器；采用场效应栅极结构进行电学调控；测量了线性透射/反射率以及三阶谐波产生效率；讨论了调制深度与速度的优化方向。

papers.title: Fully compensated ferrimagnetic triferroics and multistate transport in hidden-phase wurtzite MnSe monolayer
papers.abstract: Fully compensated ferrimagnets (fFIMs) have attracted interest due to their compensated moments and nonrelativistic spin splitting across the Brillouin zone. Known fFIMs, however, are mostly restricted to complex three-dimensional (3D) systems or require external fields in two-dimensional (2D) heterostructures, leaving intrinsic fFIM monolayers unexplored. We identify a hidden-phase MnSe monolayer, derived from the (001) planes of wurtzite, as an intrinsic fFIM featuring inequivalent sublattices not linked by any symmetry. It is a unipolar magnetic semiconductor (UMS) with perpendicular magnetic anisotropy (528.60 * 10^-3 eV per unit cell) and simultaneously exhibits ferroelectricity (polarization 4.63 * 10^-10 C/m) and ferroelasticity (signal 61%), with barriers of 7.6 * 10^-3 and 0.10 eV/f.u., respectively, establishing a single-phase triferroic system. The ground fFIM UMS characteristics are robust against strain up to 3%. The In2Se3/MnSe heterostructure enables nonvolatile electrical control between semiconducting and metallic states. Constructed tunnel junctions exhibit giant tunneling magnetoresistance (2.98 * 10^5%), electroresistance (6.97 * 10^14%), elastoresistance (7.95 * 10^4%), and near-perfect spin filtering (~100%). Collectively, this spontaneous 2D fFIM with coexisting triferroic orders provides a promising platform for ultrahigh-density, low-power, and miniaturized memory devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词包括“identify”（基于计算识别）、“perpendicular magnetic anisotropy”（计算值）、“barriers”（能垒计算）、“constructed tunnel junctions”（理论构建）等，未提及实验合成或测量。；研究对象：隐藏相纤锌矿MnSe单层（wurtzite MnSe monolayer），具体为从纤锌矿(001)面衍生出的二维单层体系，研究其完全补偿亚铁磁（fFIM）、三铁性（triferroic）及多态输运特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该MnSe单层是一种本征的完全补偿亚铁磁体，同时具有铁电性和铁弹性，构成单相三铁性体系；基于该材料构建的隧道结展现出巨大的隧穿磁电阻（2.98×10^5%）、电电阻（6.97×10^14%）和弹性电阻（7.95×10^4%），以及近完美的自旋过滤效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该MnSe单层是一种本征的完全补偿亚铁磁体，同时具有铁电性和铁弹性，构成单相三铁性体系；基于该材料构建的隧道结展现出巨大的隧穿磁电阻（2.98×10^5%）、电电阻（6.97×10^14%）和弹性电阻（7.95×10^4%），以及近完美的自旋过滤效应。；创新点：首次在二维本征单层体系中实现完全补偿亚铁磁（fFIM），并同时发现铁电性和铁弹性共存的三铁性（triferroic）特性，突破了以往fFIM局限于复杂三维体系或需要外场调控的二维异质结的限制。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（DFT），具体包括：计算磁各向异性能（528.60×10^-3 eV/晶胞）、铁电极化（4.63×10^-10 C/m）、铁弹性信号（61%）及相应能垒；构建In2Se3/MnSe异质结研究电控半导体-金属态转变；模拟隧道结输运性质以计算磁电阻、电电阻和弹性电阻比值。

papers.title: Non-invertible symmetries and modular invariance in lattice models
papers.abstract: We consider classical 2d lattice models with face interactions defined in terms of a fusion category. The symmetries of such models typically include an algebra of topological operators sitting on a closed path in the lattice. In the case when the face interactions obey the Temperley-Lieb (TL) relations, we present a generic algorithm to determine the decomposition of the transfer-matrix space of states as a direct sum of simple TL modules. We apply this approach to several examples, and analyse the action of topological operators. As an application, we compute the modular transformation of the irreducible TL characters at primitive roots of unity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：fusion category、transfer-matrix、modular transformation。；研究对象：经典二维格点模型，其面相互作用由融合范畴（fusion category）定义，特别关注满足Temperley-Lieb（TL）关系的模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种通用算法，用于将满足TL关系的格点模型的转移矩阵态空间分解为简单TL模的直和，并计算了本原单位根处不可约TL特征的模变换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种通用算法，用于将满足TL关系的格点模型的转移矩阵态空间分解为简单TL模的直和，并计算了本原单位根处不可约TL特征的模变换。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于融合范畴的代数框架，利用Temperley-Lieb代数的表示理论，通过算法分析转移矩阵态空间的模结构，并应用模变换计算特征。

papers.title: Lagrangian velocity statistics of homogeneous isotropic turbulence in dilute polymer solutions
papers.abstract: We conduct direct numerical simulations of homogeneous isotropic turbulence in dilute polymer solutions to investigate the Lagrangian velocity statistics. We show how polymers modulate the power spectral density of the Lagrangian velocity and the Lagrangian integral timescale by varying the Reynolds number, forcing method, and polymer relaxation time. As the polymer relaxation time increases, the attenuation of the power spectral density extends successively from high to low frequencies, and the Lagrangian integral timescale increases. To clarify the mechanism underlying the modulation of the Lagrangian velocity statistics, we decompose the Lagrangian velocity into the contributions from vortices at different length scales. Using this scale-decomposition analysis, we demonstrate that the observed modulation of the Lagrangian velocity statistics results from polymer-induced suppression of vortices that proceeds from smaller to larger scales.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：direct numerical simulations）；研究对象：稀聚合物溶液中的均匀各向同性湍流，具体关注拉格朗日速度统计特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 聚合物通过从较小尺度到较大尺度依次抑制涡旋，从而调制拉格朗日速度的功率谱密度和积分时间尺度：随聚合物松弛时间增加，功率谱密度衰减从高频向低频扩展，拉格朗日积分时间尺度增大。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：聚合物通过从较小尺度到较大尺度依次抑制涡旋，从而调制拉格朗日速度的功率谱密度和积分时间尺度：随聚合物松弛时间增加，功率谱密度衰减从高频向低频扩展，拉格朗日积分时间尺度增大。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 直接数值模拟（DNS），通过改变雷诺数、强迫方法和聚合物松弛时间，并结合尺度分解分析将拉格朗日速度分解为不同长度尺度涡旋的贡献。

papers.title: Unresolved-Sideband Optomechanics with Hexagonal Boron Nitride: Induced Transparency, Gain, and Frequency Combs
papers.abstract: Optomechanically induced transparency (OMIT) is usually modeled and studied in the resolved-sideband regime, but many compact microcavity platforms operate in the unresolved-sideband limit $(κ\gg Ω_m)$. Here we investigate OMIT in this regime using a tunable fiber-based Fabry-Perot microcavity coupled to a suspended hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) drum resonator in a membrane-in-the-middle geometry. The system achieves a large single-photon coupling rate of $g_0/2π\sim 180$ kHz and exhibits strong radiation-pressure backaction. By measuring OMIT spectra as a function of pump power and cavity detuning, we observe a crossover from a transparency-like dip to a gain feature in the reflected response. These maps are quantitatively reproduced by the full linearized optomechanical response, demonstrating the breakdown of the standard rotating-wave approximation used in the resolved-sideband limit. Finally, we drive the system into a nonlinear regime to generate optomechanical frequency combs. These results establish hBN fiber-cavities as a versatile architecture for unresolved-sideband optomechanics, nonlinear dynamics, and hybrid device integration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验测量（“measuring OMIT spectra”）、实验装置（“tunable fiber-based Fabry-Perot microcavity”）以及实验观察结果（“observe a crossover”）。；研究对象：基于六方氮化硼（hBN）悬浮鼓式谐振器的光纤法布里-珀罗微腔系统，具体研究该体系在非分辨边带（unresolved-sideband）光力学中的诱导透明（OMIT）、增益和频率梳现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非分辨边带极限下（κ ≫ Ω_m），通过测量OMIT光谱随泵浦功率和腔失谐的变化，观察到反射响应从透明状凹陷到增益特征的交叉，并最终驱动系统进入非线性区产生光力学频率梳。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非分辨边带极限下（κ ≫ Ω_m），通过测量OMIT光谱随泵浦功率和腔失谐的变化，观察到反射响应从透明状凹陷到增益特征的交叉，并最终驱动系统进入非线性区产生光力学频率梳。；创新点：在非分辨边带极限下系统性地研究了hBN光纤腔的OMIT行为，揭示了标准旋转波近似的失效，并展示了该体系在非线性动力学和混合器件集成方面的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用膜在中间（membrane-in-the-middle）几何结构的可调谐光纤法布里-珀罗微腔，耦合悬浮的hBN鼓式谐振器；通过测量OMIT光谱随泵浦功率和腔失谐的变化，并结合完整线性化光力学响应进行定量分析。

papers.title: Atom diffraction in the strong-coupling regime
papers.abstract: Analytic methods based on matter-wave diffraction are a cornerstone in condensed-matter research, providing access to static and dynamic materials properties down to the atomic level. In these experiments, the shape of the diffraction pattern is largely determined by the lattice at equilibrium whereas vibrationally-induced distortions are treated perturbatively. Here, we show that the perturbative approach does not hold for helium diffracted at kiloelectronvolt energy through freestanding single-layer graphene. In this case, we enter a new regime of strong coupling where the projectile strongly interacts with the electron density of several lattice atoms simultaneously, leading to phase shifts of several radians. In consequence, lattice distortions introduce a significant phase spread that cannot be described by the typically employed Debye-Waller factor. We show that the weak-coupling regime is retained for atomic hydrogen diffraction. The experimental results are supported by simulations, providing a regime-independent approach to describe the influence of phonons on atom diffraction phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要中同时描述了实验观测（“helium diffracted at kiloelectronvolt energy through freestanding single-layer graphene”）和理论模拟（“The experimental results are supported by simulations”）。；研究对象：原子在强耦合区通过自由悬挂单层石墨烯的衍射现象，具体涉及氦原子（He）和氢原子（H）的衍射行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在千电子伏特能量下，氦原子通过单层石墨烯时进入强耦合区，其与多个晶格原子的电子密度同时发生强相互作用，导致相位偏移达数弧度，此时晶格畸变引起的相位展宽无法用传统的德拜-沃勒因子描述；而氢原子衍射仍保持弱耦合区。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在千电子伏特能量下，氦原子通过单层石墨烯时进入强耦合区，其与多个晶格原子的电子密度同时发生强相互作用，导致相位偏移达数弧度，此时晶格畸变引起的相位展宽无法用传统的德拜-沃勒因子描述；而氢原子衍射仍保持弱耦合区。；创新点：揭示了原子衍射中强耦合区的存在，并证明传统微扰方法（如德拜-沃勒因子）在此区域失效，同时提出了一种适用于任意耦合强度的新描述框架。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用千电子伏特能量氦原子和氢原子对自由悬挂单层石墨烯进行衍射；理论上通过模拟提供与实验一致的结果，并建立了一种与耦合强度无关的描述声子对原子衍射影响的方法。

papers.title: Explaining Machine Learning and Memorization with Statistical Mechanics
papers.abstract: Artificial neural networks (NNs) and machine learning (ML) algorithms are poorly understood from a theoretical perspective, which makes it difficult to fully realize their potential and overcome their weaknesses. For instance, ML algorithms train NN weights by moving them along a low-dimensional subspace of their allowed values, but this implicitly low-dimensional learning structure is not properly exploited to improve training because its nature is not well understood. Moreover, trained NNs are easily confused by pervasive adversarial attacks whose theoretical underpinnings are still unclear. This thesis aims to improve our theoretical understanding of NNs and ML, with a particular focus on adversarial attacks and implicitly low-dimensional learning. For this purpose, we use mathematical tools from statistical mechanics to study different types of NNs and ways in which they can fit the data. In particular, we study two classes of models that fit the data with various degrees of learning and memorization: dense associative memory (DAM) and restricted Boltzmann machines (RBM). In the process, we investigate connections between different versions of these models that are useful to make analytical investigations more efficient.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“statistical mechanics”、“mathematical tools”、“analytical investigations”。；研究对象：人工神经网络（NNs）与机器学习（ML）算法，具体聚焦于两类模型：密集联想记忆（DAM）和受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过统计力学工具，揭示了神经网络在数据拟合过程中学习与记忆的不同程度，并探讨了对抗攻击与隐式低维学习结构的理论根源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过统计力学工具，揭示了神经网络在数据拟合过程中学习与记忆的不同程度，并探讨了对抗攻击与隐式低维学习结构的理论根源。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用统计力学的数学工具，对密集联想记忆（DAM）和受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）两类模型进行理论分析，并研究了不同版本模型之间的关联以提升分析效率。

papers.title: Controllable Thouless Pumping Switching Dynamics of Gap Solitons Mediated by Finite Bogoliubov Excitations
papers.abstract: We investigate the Thouless pumping dynamics of nonlinear gap solitons and attempt to realize topological Chern number switching by modulating nonlinear parameters and varying the ramping rate of the relative phase between periodic potentials. We find that gap solitons can undergo nonlinear instabilities accompanied by finite Bogoliubov excitations under near-adiabatic ramping. Such finite Bogoliubov excitations induce the particle loss of the solitons, leading to reversed propagation directions that signals the occurrence of Chern number switching with analyzing the correspondence between soliton chemical potential and Bloch topological energy band. Our findings offer a feasible strategy for manipulating the Thouless pump dynamics of gap solitons mediated by finite Bogoliubov excitations, with implications for topological quantum transport and quantum computing applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“investigate”、“analyzing”、“offer a feasible strategy”，主要基于理论分析和数值模拟，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：非线性间隙孤子（gap solitons）的Thouless泵浦动力学，以及通过有限Bogoliubov激发调控拓扑陈数（Chern number）切换的物理过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在近绝热扫描过程中，非线性间隙孤子会因有限Bogoliubov激发而失稳，导致孤子粒子数损失并发生传播方向反转，这一反转标志着陈数切换的发生。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在近绝热扫描过程中，非线性间隙孤子会因有限Bogoliubov激发而失稳，导致孤子粒子数损失并发生传播方向反转，这一反转标志着陈数切换的发生。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异，但核心新意在于揭示了有限Bogoliubov激发可作为中介机制，实现间隙孤子Thouless泵浦中陈数切换的可控调控。
papers.method_zh: 通过调节非线性参数和周期性势阱间相对相位的扫描速率，分析孤子化学势与布洛赫拓扑能带之间的对应关系，并利用Bogoliubov激发理论描述非线性不稳定性。

papers.title: Phase Transition and Censorship Principle for Holographic Casimir Effect
papers.abstract: This paper explores the holographic Casimir effect associated with parallel spherical defects. The gravity dual is dominated by the AdS soliton with connected EOW branes at small widths, transitioning to AdS space with disconnected EOW branes as the width increases. Consequently, the holographic Casimir effect undergoes a first-order phase transition and vanishes in the disconnected phase. This new behavior highlights a significant difference from free theories, holographic parallel plane defects, and hyperbolic defects. Additionally, we confirm that the free theories adhere to the holographic bound for the Casimir effect in the case of parallel spherical defects. Interestingly, we observe that cosmic censorship provides a holographic interpretation of the attractive nature of the Casimir force when identical boundary conditions are imposed on both parallel surfaces. The repulsive Casimir force is associated with the bulk spacetime containing a naked singularity, which is generally considered forbidden. Additionally, we argue that topological censorship offers a natural explanation for why the vacuum of parallel defects is dual to the AdS soliton.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：holographic Casimir effect（全息卡西米尔效应）、gravity dual（引力对偶）、AdS soliton（AdS孤子）。；研究对象：全息卡西米尔效应，具体为平行球形缺陷（parallel spherical defects）体系中的真空涨落现象及其相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 全息卡西米尔效应在平行球形缺陷体系中发生一级相变：在小宽度下由AdS孤子与连接的EOW膜主导，在大宽度下转变为断开EOW膜的AdS空间，此时卡西米尔效应消失。此外，宇宙监督原理为卡西米尔力的吸引/排斥性质提供了全息解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：全息卡西米尔效应在平行球形缺陷体系中发生一级相变：在小宽度下由AdS孤子与连接的EOW膜主导，在大宽度下转变为断开EOW膜的AdS空间，此时卡西米尔效应消失。此外，宇宙监督原理为卡西米尔力的吸引/排斥性质提供了全息解释。；创新点：首次揭示了平行球形缺陷中全息卡西米尔效应的一级相变行为，并指出该行为与自由理论、全息平行平面缺陷及双曲缺陷存在显著差异。同时，利用宇宙监督原理解释了卡西米尔力的吸引性质，并指出排斥力对应含裸奇点的体时空（通常被禁止）。
papers.method_zh: 采用全息对偶（AdS/CFT对应）框架，通过构造AdS孤子与EOW膜（end-of-world branes）的引力构型，分析不同宽度下体系的引力对偶相变，并利用宇宙监督原理和拓扑监督原理进行物理诠释。

papers.title: An Enhanced RPA-LDA Model for Ion Stopping Power from Cold Matter to High-Energy Density Plasmas: A Unified, Open-Source Framework
papers.abstract: We present an enhanced random-phase-approximation--local-density-approximation (e-RPA-LDA) model for the stopping power of ions that is valid over a wide range of conditions, from cold solids through warm dense matter to high-energy-density plasmas. The electronic stopping is computed from the RPA dielectric response in the local-density approximation over an average-atom electron density obtained in a muffin-tin potential with the Flexible Atomic Code, augmented by four corrections to the earlier RPA-LDA model of Wang et al.: a strong-collision correction for large-momentum-transfer events, a static local-field correction for electron correlations, an electron-binding correction, and the higher-order Barkas and Bloch terms. The resulting proton stopping powers agree with the NIST PSTAR and IAEA databases across the periodic table and for compounds -- providing a physics-based alternative to semi-empirical codes such as SRIM -- and reproduce the limited published plasma data, including charged-particle transport-workshop benchmarks, time-dependent DFT calculations, and the first measurements of enhanced light-ion stopping in plasmas. We further extend the model to a complete total stopping power for protons and alpha particles by adding nuclear and ionic (elastic ion-ion) stopping to the electronic term, yielding a continuous, self-consistent description of energy deposition from cold matter to hot dense plasmas. Because the average-atom treatment includes contributions from all electrons -- unlike Kohn-Sham DFT -- while remaining computationally efficient and applicable to low- and high-Z targets at arbitrary temperature and degeneracy, the model is well suited to inertial fusion and high-energy-density science. The computational framework is available on GitHub (https://github.com/dedx-erpa/dedx), with tabulated stopping powers and ranges in the data/ subdirectory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“present an enhanced random-phase-approximation--local-density-approximation (e-RPA-LDA) model”，并基于该模型进行计算和数据库对比，未涉及实验测量。；研究对象：离子（质子、α粒子）在从冷固体、温稠密物质到高能量密度等离子体等宽范围条件下的阻止本领（stopping power）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该增强型RPA-LDA模型计算出的质子阻止本领与NIST PSTAR和IAEA数据库在全周期表和化合物中吻合，并能复现有限的已发表等离子体实验数据，包括时间依赖DFT计算和等离子体中轻离子增强阻止的首批测量结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该增强型RPA-LDA模型计算出的质子阻止本领与NIST PSTAR和IAEA数据库在全周期表和化合物中吻合，并能复现有限的已发表等离子体实验数据，包括时间依赖DFT计算和等离子体中轻离子增强阻止的首批测量结果。；创新点：在Wang等人早期RPA-LDA模型基础上增加了四项物理修正，使模型从冷物质到高能量密度等离子体连续有效；采用平均原子处理（而非Kohn-Sham DFT）包含所有电子贡献，计算高效且适用于任意温度和简并度下的低Z和高Z靶材；提供了开源计算框架（GitHub）。
papers.method_zh: 基于RPA介电响应理论，结合局域密度近似（LDA）和平均原子模型（使用Flexible Atomic Code在muffin-tin势中计算电子密度），并引入四项修正：强碰撞修正、静态局域场修正、电子束缚修正、以及高阶Barkas和Bloch项。模型还通过加入核阻止和离子（弹性离子-离子）阻止，扩展为质子和α粒子的完整总阻止本领。

papers.title: Extension of openCOSMO-RS Into a Full Open-Source Equation of State: Implementation, Parameterization, and Benchmarking
papers.abstract: The COSMO-SAC-Phi model developed by Soares et al. extends the COSMO-SAC activity-coefficient framework into a full equation of state by explicitly accounting for pressure effects. In this approach, pure substances and mixtures are represented as pseudo-mixtures consisting of the actual number of moles and an additional pseudo-component that describes free volume, or holes. In this work, we implement this extension within the openCOSMO-RS framework and evaluate it using a large and diverse set of molecules and binary systems. The resulting equation of state includes an extensive open-source parameter set with around 1800 pure-component entries, made freely available to the academic community. The four pure-component parameters were fitted to vapor-pressure and liquid-molar volume data for each substance. Model performance was assessed against two benchmark equation-of-state databases, one for pure compounds and one for binary mixtures, without introducing any binary interaction parameters. The resulting openCOSMO-RS-Phi model reproduces the accuracy of the original COSMO-SAC-Phi formulation while providing a fully open-source and accessible implementation for the scientific community. Beyond its immediate utility, it also establishes a foundation for future development of predictive EoS for electrolyte solutions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：implementation（实现）、parameterization（参数化）、benchmarking（基准测试）、equation of state（状态方程）。；研究对象：纯物质和二元混合物的热力学性质，具体包括约1800种纯组分的汽-液平衡（蒸气压、液体摩尔体积）以及二元混合物的相行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将COSMO-SAC-Phi模型扩展为全开源状态方程（openCOSMO-RS-Phi），在不引入任何二元相互作用参数的情况下，复现了原始COSMO-SAC-Phi模型的精度，并提供了完整的开源参数集。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将COSMO-SAC-Phi模型扩展为全开源状态方程（openCOSMO-RS-Phi），在不引入任何二元相互作用参数的情况下，复现了原始COSMO-SAC-Phi模型的精度，并提供了完整的开源参数集。；创新点：将COSMO-SAC-Phi模型首次完整实现于开源openCOSMO-RS框架中，并公开了约1800个纯组分的开源参数集，为电解质溶液等领域的预测性状态方程开发奠定了基础。
papers.method_zh: 基于COSMO-SAC-Phi理论框架，将纯物质和混合物表示为包含实际摩尔数和描述自由体积（空穴）的虚拟组分的伪混合物，显式考虑压力效应。通过拟合约1800种纯组分的蒸气压和液体摩尔体积数据获得四个纯组分参数，并利用两个基准状态方程数据库（纯物质和二元混合物）进行性能评估。

papers.title: Overcoming Configuration Bottleneck: Modular Pathways to Stable Semiconductor Spin-Qubit Arrays
papers.abstract: Over the past decade, semiconductor spin qubits have progressed from few-qubit demonstrations towards larger-scale devices fabricated in increasingly reproducible academic and industrial processes. This progress marks an inflection point: the central challenge is no longer to demonstrate high-fidelity operation in carefully tuned devices, but to discover, verify, and maintain stable operating conditions reliably across many interdependent controls, varied device geometries, and disparate material platforms. In this Perspective, we frame spin-qubit operation as a modular automation problem. We decompose the workflow into five modules: bootstrapping from minimal prior information, configuration tuning, virtualization of physical gates into effective control axes, qubit-level tuning, and an operation layer with drift-aware maintenance. Using recent demonstrations from our work and the broader community, we argue that scalability will depend on explicit interfaces between modules, standardized intermediate data products, and workflow-level metrics such as throughput, success probability, stability time, recovery time, and robustness. We close by outlining the infrastructure needed to move beyond isolated tuning demonstrations toward sustained operation: qubit-performance-aware feedback, reusable software and benchmark tasks, and tight collaboration among experimental, theoretical, and software efforts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/观点文章（Perspective）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“In this Perspective”，并主要进行问题框架化、工作流分解和未来展望，而非报告新的实验或计算结果。；研究对象：半导体自旋量子比特阵列。具体涉及在可重复的学术和工业流程中制造的大规模半导体自旋量子比特器件。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 半导体自旋量子比特领域的核心挑战已从在精心调谐的器件中展示高保真度操作，转变为如何可靠地发现、验证并维持跨多个相互依赖的控制参数、不同器件几何结构和材料平台的稳定工作条件。本文将此问题框架化为一个模块化自动化问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：半导体自旋量子比特领域的核心挑战已从在精心调谐的器件中展示高保真度操作，转变为如何可靠地发现、验证并维持跨多个相互依赖的控制参数、不同器件几何结构和材料平台的稳定工作条件。本文将此问题框架化为一个模块化自动化问题。；创新点：本文的核心创新在于将自旋量子比特的规模化操作明确地重新定义为一个模块化自动化工程问题，而非单纯的物理问题。它强调了模块间显式接口、标准化中间数据产品以及工作流级性能指标的重要性，并呼吁建立可复用的软件、基准测试任务以及实验、理论和软件团队的紧密协作，以推动从孤立的调谐演示向持续稳定运行的转变。
papers.method_zh: 本文采用概念框架构建和文献综述的方法。具体地，将自旋量子比特操作工作流分解为五个模块：1）基于最小先验信息的自举启动；2）配置调谐；3）物理门到有效控制轴的虚拟化；4）量子比特级调谐；5）包含漂移感知维护的操作层。并提出了工作流级别的度量标准（如吞吐量、成功率、稳定性时间、恢复时间、鲁棒性）。

papers.title: Diffusion-warm sampling of the XY model enables fast thermalization at scale
papers.abstract: We introduce a novel technique for scalable sampling of spin-system states with continuous symmetries using diffusion models. By applying our approach to the XY model, a fundamental continuous-spin model in condensed matter physics, we show that our technique addresses the shortfalls of the Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) in generalization to varying system sizes. More specifically, we show that training a temperature-conditioned diffusion model on smaller-size XY model lattices enables the generation of accurate samples in larger lattice sizes. By tracking physically important observables of the model, such as spin correlations, our experiments demonstrate that diffusion sampling followed by a few MCMC steps reduces the thermalization time by an order of magnitude relative to the standard MCMC with random initialization. Our study provides valuable insight as to how generative models can be used to study continuous-state condensed matter systems at scale.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“diffusion models”、“Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC)”、“sampling”、“experiments demonstrate”（指计算实验）。；研究对象：XY模型，一种凝聚态物理中具有连续自旋对称性的基本自旋模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用扩散模型对较小尺寸XY模型晶格进行温度条件化训练，能够生成较大尺寸晶格上的准确样本；结合少量MCMC步骤，可将热化时间相比标准MCMC（随机初始化）降低一个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用扩散模型对较小尺寸XY模型晶格进行温度条件化训练，能够生成较大尺寸晶格上的准确样本；结合少量MCMC步骤，可将热化时间相比标准MCMC（随机初始化）降低一个数量级。；创新点：提出一种基于扩散模型的可扩展采样技术，解决了MCMC在推广到不同系统尺寸时的局限性，实现了从较小晶格到较大晶格的连续自旋系统高效热化。
papers.method_zh: 扩散模型（diffusion models）用于采样，结合温度条件化训练；后续辅以少量马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）步骤；通过追踪自旋关联等物理可观测量评估采样质量。

papers.title: Disorder-Induced Enhancement of Fermionic Superradiance
papers.abstract: Collective light-matter phenomena such as Dicke superradiance are often described as a collection of effective spins coupled homogeneously to a bosonic mode, giving rise to a collective bright mode with enhanced light-matter coupling. In fermionic systems, Pauli exclusion and Fermi-surface structure can significantly modify this picture, while randomness in the atom-light couplings raises the question of whether disorder promotes or suppresses collective behavior. Here, we study a cavity model in which fermionic particles couple to a photonic mode through a random all-to-all interaction matrix with tunable mean and variance. Combining numerical mean-field methods, analytic stability analysis and random-matrix predictions, and benchmarks against exact diagonalization, we characterize both the onset and structure of the superradiant phase. While mean coupling and disorder variance contribute in the same way to the onset, they lead to drastically different behavior within the condensed phase. Uniform coupling supports a single bright collective fermionic mode with conventional Dicke-like scaling of the cavity field. Disorder, instead, gives rise to a qualitatively different collective regime in which many grey fermionic states participate coherently, producing a parametrically enhanced scaling of the condensate with system size. Our results reveal a mechanism through which disorder can, perhaps counterintuitively, promote collective light-matter phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：mean-field methods, analytic stability analysis, random-matrix predictions, exact diagonalization）；研究对象：费米子与光腔耦合系统中的超辐射现象，特别是无序（随机耦合）对集体光-物质行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 无序可以增强费米子超辐射，在凝聚相中产生一种新的集体态：许多“灰色”费米子态相干参与，导致凝聚体随系统尺寸出现参数增强的标度行为，这与均匀耦合下单一亮模的Dicke标度截然不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：无序可以增强费米子超辐射，在凝聚相中产生一种新的集体态：许多“灰色”费米子态相干参与，导致凝聚体随系统尺寸出现参数增强的标度行为，这与均匀耦合下单一亮模的Dicke标度截然不同。；创新点：揭示了无序（随机全对耦合矩阵）在费米子系统中可能反常地促进集体光-物质现象，而非通常预期的抑制效应，并发现了无序诱导的“灰色”多模集体态及其增强标度律。
papers.method_zh: 结合数值平均场方法、解析稳定性分析、随机矩阵理论预测，并以精确对角化作为基准进行验证。

papers.title: Controlling the non-Markovianity of quantum Brownian motion
papers.abstract: We analyze the exact dynamics of a generalized quantum Brownian motion model, employing Gaussian master equation methods. We demonstrate that, by modulating the relative weights of specific interaction channels, we can control the degree of non-Markovianity of the system, and induce a transition from non-Markovian to Markovian regimes. The non-Markovianity of the evolution is formally characterized by leveraging the Gorini--Kossakowski--Sudarshan--Lindblad theorem and by employing quantitative measures of information backflow. Finally, we clarify the physical mechanism behind the phenomenology of this model, thereby providing a systematic platform for environment engineering through the strategic tuning of dissipation channels.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“exact dynamics”“Gaussian master equation methods”“Gorini--Kossakowski--Sudarshan--Lindblad theorem”等理论框架和数学工具，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：广义量子布朗运动模型中的非马尔可夫性控制。具体体系为通过调节相互作用通道权重来调控系统与环境耦合的耗散动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节特定相互作用通道的相对权重，可以控制系统的非马尔可夫性程度，并诱导从非马尔可夫到马尔可夫动力学的转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节特定相互作用通道的相对权重，可以控制系统的非马尔可夫性程度，并诱导从非马尔可夫到马尔可夫动力学的转变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但指出该工作通过战略性地调谐耗散通道，为环境工程提供了一个系统平台，并阐明了该模型现象背后的物理机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用高斯主方程方法分析精确动力学；利用Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad定理对非马尔可夫性进行形式化表征；采用信息回溯的定量度量来量化非马尔可夫性。

papers.title: Complex Conformal Manifolds
papers.abstract: Complex conformal field theories (CFTs) have recently emerged as essential frameworks for understanding non-Hermitian criticality, weakly first-order phase transitions, and walking renormalization group flows, while their general structures remain largely unknown. In this work, we propose a systematic construction of complex CFTs by analytically continuing exactly marginal couplings into the complex plane. This procedure applies uniformly to bulk, boundary, and defect deformations, preserving conformal symmetry while generically complexifying operator spectra and other universal data. Using the compact free boson as a solvable laboratory, we uncover the global structure of the complexified Gaussian conformal manifold. More generally, we demonstrate that genuinely complex rational CFTs do not exist: rational points remain confined to the real regime, providing a sharp distinction between real and complex theories. In the defect case, we investigate the one-parameter family of conformal defects in the Ising CFT and derive exact expressions for the defect spectrum, energy transmission coefficient, and effective central charge from analytic continuation. The theoretical predictions are precisely verified in non-Hermitian critical Ising and free fermion chains using bulk-defect correlators, entanglement entropy, and complex energy transport, providing concrete evidence for the complex defect conformal manifold. Finally, we study complex boundary renormalization-group flows through the AdS/BCFT correspondence. Our results establish complex conformal manifolds as a controlled bridge between solvable lattice models, complex CFTs, and holography, while providing stringent analytic benchmarks for the nonunitary conformal bootstrap.

papers.title: Unsupervised Thermodynamics of Molecular Diffusion Models: Action-Operator Semantics and Auditable Free-Energy Readout
papers.abstract: Diffusion models are increasingly utilized for modeling molecular structures and conformational ensembles, yet the thermodynamic meaning of their learned representations and scores remains elusive. To resolve this ambiguity, we introduce a mathematically consistent action-operator framework natively compatible with diffusion models. By defining a fixed molecular environment as a base action $S_0(x)$ and an alchemical perturbation as an operator $O(x)$, standard diffusion noising induces effective noised actions and operators whose gradients and alchemical derivatives are directly represented by the model's learned fields. This rigorous self-consistency enables a ``noisy operator bridge'' capable of reading out free-energy differences ($ΔF$) from endpoint ensembles and per-frame evaluations. In controlled experiments on alanine dipeptide systems, we show that incorporating physical inductive biases enables partial recovery of the base action and perturbation operator. When applied to a challenging C6-H to C6-F ligand-pocket nonbonded perturbation (185L/IND) with negligible phase-space overlap, our supervised bridge estimates the alchemical $ΔF$ within approximately $1\ k_\mathrm{B}T$ of a stable 19-state MBAR reference. Finally, we demonstrate that endpoint coordinates and binary labels alone are sufficient to partially recover the operator shape and a centered free-energy scale without any force or action supervision. This work provides a rigorous path toward transforming generative molecular diffusion models from black-box coordinate samplers into auditable thermodynamic estimators.

papers.title: Large CISS Polarization from the Hierarchy Between Transport and Geometrical Spin Currents
papers.abstract: Large spin polarization observed in chiral-induced spin selectivity (CISS) remains difficult to explain quantitatively. Experimental polarizations measured in chiral molecular systems are often substantially larger than expected from weak microscopic spin-orbit interaction in organic materials. We revisit the geometrical spin current introduced previously for electrons constrained to curved paths and propose a scale argument relevant to transport through double-stranded DNA (dsDNA). Estimation of the intrinsic geometrical spin-current scale using representative dsDNA parameters yields current magnitudes substantially larger than measured transport currents in many CISS experiments. We suggest that this hierarchy allows transport to be interpreted as weak leakage from underlying curved spin-current states. Within this picture, large CISS polarization emerges as transport selection of pre-existing spin-current branches.

papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出在dsDNA等手性分子体系中，几何自旋电流的本征尺度远大于实际测量的输运电流，因此输运可视为对底层弯曲自旋电流态的弱泄漏，从而解释CISS中观测到的大自旋极化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出在dsDNA等手性分子体系中，几何自旋电流的本征尺度远大于实际测量的输运电流，因此输运可视为对底层弯曲自旋电流态的弱泄漏，从而解释CISS中观测到的大自旋极化。；创新点：提出输运电流与几何自旋电流之间的尺度层级关系，将CISS大极化解释为输运对预存自旋电流分支的选择，而非直接源于弱自旋-轨道耦合。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：重新审视电子在弯曲路径约束下的几何自旋电流概念，利用代表性dsDNA参数估算几何自旋电流的尺度，并与实验输运电流进行比较，建立尺度层级论证。

papers.title: Magnetism and magnetoelastic effect in the two-dimensional van der Waals multiferroic ${\mathrm{CuCrP}}_{2}{\mathrm{S}}_{6}$
papers.abstract: The ordered moment direction in the van der Waals multiferroic CuCrP2S6 remains unresolved despite growing research interest. Here, the authors have determined the ground-state magnetic structure using neutron diffraction, revealing that the ordered moments align along the crystallographic b axis with weak spin anisotropy. Magnetic field measurements further uncover a magnetoelastic coupling. This work provides firm basis for future magnetoelectric study and in situ diffraction of strain-tunable magnetism in this two-dimensional magnet.

papers.title: Rashba-driven insights into molecular excitons
papers.abstract: Author(s): Hao Li, Sergei Tretiak, and Vladimir Chernyak Emmanuel Rashba’s enduring influence on molecular exciton physics is reflected in several foundational concepts: excitons in the narrow-band limit, impurity-induced spectral anomalies, the giant oscillator strength of shallow impurity-bound excitons, and isotopic editing as a quantitative spectroscopic tool. Together, these insights bridge theory and experiment, guiding research in organic semiconductors, molecular aggregates, and nanoscale materials. Rashba’s vision continues to inspire modern multiscale modeling and the design of excitonic functionality in current quantum and optoelectronic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：insights、concepts、bridge theory and experiment、multiscale modeling）；研究对象：分子激子（molecular excitons），具体涉及有机半导体、分子聚集体和纳米材料中的激子物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Rashba在分子激子物理中提出的若干基础概念（窄带极限激子、杂质诱导光谱异常、浅杂质束缚激子的巨振荡强度、同位素编辑作为定量光谱工具）对连接理论与实验、指导现代量子与光电材料中的激子功能设计具有持续影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Rashba在分子激子物理中提出的若干基础概念（窄带极限激子、杂质诱导光谱异常、浅杂质束缚激子的巨振荡强度、同位素编辑作为定量光谱工具）对连接理论与实验、指导现代量子与光电材料中的激子功能设计具有持续影响。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，主要强调Rashba系列概念对分子激子领域的长期指导意义。
papers.method_zh: 理论概念分析与综述，未涉及具体实验手段或计算框架（摘要未明确说明具体方法）。

papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未完整给出核心发现，但指出在有序与无序共存的体系中（如超离子冰），传统声子理论中动量作为好量子数的条件被破坏，需要重新审视声子的概念。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未完整给出核心发现，但指出在有序与无序共存的体系中（如超离子冰），传统声子理论中动量作为好量子数的条件被破坏，需要重新审视声子的概念。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断：首次系统讨论在原子扩散（而非静态无序）条件下声子概念的适用性，并将该理论框架应用于超离子冰这一具体体系。

papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“investigate the dependence of the transmission parameter S21”（研究传输参数S21的依赖性），表明是测量工作。；研究对象：超导共面波导谐振器中的Abrikosov涡旋动力学。具体材料为铌（niobium）制成的四分之一波长共面波导谐振器。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未完整提供，但根据标题，核心发现是：在超导共面谐振器中，由Abrikosov涡旋驱动导致传输参数S21出现等间距的共振跳变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未完整提供，但根据标题，核心发现是：在超导共面谐振器中，由Abrikosov涡旋驱动导致传输参数S21出现等间距的共振跳变。；创新点：摘要未完整提供，无法判断。标题中的“Equidistant resonance jumps”（等间距共振跳变）可能是一个新的实验观测现象。
papers.method_zh: 通过测量超导共面波导谐振器的传输参数S21来研究涡旋行为。具体实验手段摘要未明确说明，但通常涉及低温微波测量技术。

papers.title: Superconducting state with broken time-reversal symmetry and collective modes in the kagome superconductors $A{\mathrm{V}}_{3}{\mathrm{Sb}}_{5}$ ($A=\mathrm{K}$, Cs, Rb)
papers.abstract: We comprehensively study the unconventional pairing and collective modes in the multiband kagome superconductors AV3Sb5 (A=K,Cs,Rb). By solving gap equations at zero temperature, we identify a transition from normal (s++/s±)-wave pairing to time-reversal symmetry- (TRS) breaking pairing with a varia…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“comprehensively study”、“solving gap equations”、“identify a transition”。；研究对象：多带笼目（kagome）超导体 \( A\mathrm{V}_3\mathrm{Sb}_5 \)（\( A=\mathrm{K}, \mathrm{Cs}, \mathrm{Rb} \)）中的非常规配对态和集体激发模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零温下，通过求解能隙方程，发现该体系存在从正常（\( s^{++}/s^{\pm} \)）波配对到破坏时间反演对称性（TRS）的配对态的转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零温下，通过求解能隙方程，发现该体系存在从正常（\( s^{++}/s^{\pm} \)）波配对到破坏时间反演对称性（TRS）的配对态的转变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过求解零温下的能隙方程（gap equations）进行理论分析，研究多带超导配对态及其集体模式。

papers.title: Melting behavior of ${\mathrm{MgSiO}}_{3}, {\mathrm{CaSiO}}_{3}$, and ${\mathrm{SiO}}_{2}$ at Earth's mantle conditions based on machine learning potentials
papers.abstract: This study employs Deep-Potential (DP) models with varying exchange-correlation (XC) functional accuracies, combined with large-scale two-phase molecular dynamics simulations, to determine the melting curves of key minerals SiO2 (coesite, stishovite, and β-stishovite), MgSiO3 (perovskite and postper…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“Deep-Potential (DP) models”、“machine learning potentials”、“molecular dynamics simulations”。；研究对象：地球下地幔条件下关键矿物的熔化行为，具体包括：SiO₂（柯石英、斯石英和β-斯石英）、MgSiO₃（钙钛矿和后钙钛矿相）以及CaSiO₃（摘要中未明确列出其具体相，但根据标题推断为相关矿物）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论，仅指出研究旨在确定上述矿物的熔化曲线。核心发现需阅读全文后获知。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论，仅指出研究旨在确定上述矿物的熔化曲线。核心发现需阅读全文后获知。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断，使用机器学习势（DP模型）进行大规模、高精度的两相模拟，以系统研究多种地幔矿物在极端条件下的熔化曲线，是相对于传统经验势或第一性原理分子动力学方法的主要新意。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于不同交换关联泛函精度的深度势能（Deep-Potential, DP）模型，并结合大规模两相分子动力学模拟。

papers.title: Ab initio modeling and experimental analysis of contrast in broadband coherent anti-Stokes Raman spectroscopy: A case study on ferroelectric domain walls
papers.abstract: Author(s): Robin Buschbeck, Mike N. Pionteck, Naomi Herrmann, Michael Rüsing, Susanne C. Kehr, Simone Sanna, and Lukas M. Eng Raman imaging, based on incoherent spontaneous Raman scattering (SR) or coherent techniques such as broadband coherent anti-Stokes Raman spectroscopy (BCARS), is a powerful tool for visualizing local lattice distortions. It can thus be employed, e.g., to identify and visualize ferroelectric (FE) dom…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中同时提到“ab initio modeling”（第一性原理建模）和“experimental analysis”（实验分析），以及“Raman imaging”（拉曼成像）实验手段。；研究对象：铁电畴壁（ferroelectric domain walls）的宽带相干反斯托克斯拉曼光谱（BCARS）成像对比度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体物理结论，仅指出该工作通过第一性原理建模与实验分析相结合，研究BCARS成像中对比度的来源，以铁电畴壁为案例。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体物理结论，仅指出该工作通过第一性原理建模与实验分析相结合，研究BCARS成像中对比度的来源，以铁电畴壁为案例。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理建模（ab initio modeling）用于理论模拟；实验上采用宽带相干反斯托克斯拉曼光谱（BCARS）进行成像分析，并与非相干自发拉曼散射（SR）成像进行对比。

papers.title: Ferroelectricity in a magnon Bose-Einstein condensate: Nonreciprocal superfluidity, exceptional points, and Majorana bosons
papers.abstract: We investigate a ferroelectric instability of a magnon Bose-Einstein condensate, mediated by its interaction with an electric field through a geometric Aharonov-Casher (AC) phase. A distinct feature of the system is the positive feedback loop in which an electric field induces magnon orbital motion …
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We investigate”（我们研究）、“mediated by”（通过…介导）等理论推导常用语，并提出了“positive feedback loop”（正反馈回路）等理论机制，未提及任何实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：磁振子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（magnon Bose-Einstein condensate）中的铁电不稳定性。具体物理现象是：通过几何阿哈罗诺夫-卡舍尔（Aharonov-Casher, AC）相位，磁振子凝聚体与电场相互作用所导致的铁电性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明最终的核心物理结论。摘要仅指出该体系的一个显著特征是存在一个正反馈回路：电场会诱导磁振子轨道运动，但该回路最终导致何种物理结果（如铁电序的形成、超流性的非互易性等）尚未在摘要中给出。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明最终的核心物理结论。摘要仅指出该体系的一个显著特征是存在一个正反馈回路：电场会诱导磁振子轨道运动，但该回路最终导致何种物理结果（如铁电序的形成、超流性的非互易性等）尚未在摘要中给出。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。摘要仅指出该工作的研究对象是磁振子凝聚体中的铁电性，但未与已有研究进行对比来明确其创新之处。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体框架是基于几何阿哈罗诺夫-卡舍尔（AC）相位来描述磁振子与电场的相互作用，并以此研究磁振子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的铁电不稳定性。

papers.title: Raman response of collective modes in multicomponent superconductors
papers.abstract: We formulate a microscopic theory of the Raman response of superconducting collective modes in multicomponent superconductors. Starting from a general Bogoliubov–de Gennes (BdG) Hamiltonian with a separable pairing interaction, we derive a gauge-invariant expression for the Raman susceptibility, inc…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“formulate a microscopic theory”（构建微观理论）、“derive a gauge-invariant expression”（推导规范不变表达式）。；研究对象：多组分超导体中的集体激发模式（collective modes）的拉曼响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从一般的Bogoliubov–de Gennes (BdG)哈密顿量出发，推导出了多组分超导体中集体模式的拉曼响应的规范不变表达式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从一般的Bogoliubov–de Gennes (BdG)哈密顿量出发，推导出了多组分超导体中集体模式的拉曼响应的规范不变表达式。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于可分离配对相互作用的BdG形式理论框架，推导了拉曼极化率的解析表达式。

papers.title: Interface effects of Pb films on ${\mathrm{TlBiSe}}_{2}$ and ${\mathrm{Bi}}_{2}{\mathrm{Se}}_{3}$ topological insulators
papers.abstract: We present an experimental investigation of the Pb-induced changes on the electronic structure of selected topological insulators, namely, TlBiSe2 and Bi2Se3. Using spatially resolved and surface-sensitive techniques, including micro-angle-resolved photoemission (μ-ARPES) and micro-core-level photoe…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“实验研究”（experimental investigation）以及使用了“空间分辨和表面敏感技术”（spatially resolved and surface-sensitive techniques）。；研究对象：Pb薄膜沉积在拓扑绝缘体TlBiSe₂和Bi₂Se₃表面所形成的界面体系。具体研究Pb诱导的电子结构变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明核心物理结论。摘要仅指出研究目的是探究Pb对选定拓扑绝缘体电子结构的改变，但未给出具体发现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明核心物理结论。摘要仅指出研究目的是探究Pb对选定拓扑绝缘体电子结构的改变，但未给出具体发现。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。摘要仅描述了研究内容，未与已有工作进行对比或强调新意。
papers.method_zh: 微区角分辨光电子能谱（μ-ARPES）和微区芯能级光电子能谱（micro-core-level photoemission）。这些是空间分辨且表面敏感的实验技术。
keywords: electronic structure and strongly correlated systems

papers.title: Continuum fractons: Quantization and the few-body problem
papers.abstract: We formulate a continuum quantum mechanics for nonrelativistic, dipole-conserving fractons. Imposing symmetries and locality results in novel phenomena absent in ordinary quantum mechanical systems. A single fracton has a vanishing Hamiltonian, and thus its spectrum is entirely composed of zero mode…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：formulate a continuum quantum mechanics、imposing symmetries and locality。；研究对象：论文研究的是非相对论性、偶极矩守恒的 fracton（分形子）的连续量子力学体系，具体关注其量子化过程及少体问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单个 fracton 的哈密顿量为零，因此其能谱完全由零模式构成，这导致了普通量子力学系统中不存在的全新物理现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单个 fracton 的哈密顿量为零，因此其能谱完全由零模式构成，这导致了普通量子力学系统中不存在的全新物理现象。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据标题和摘要，其创新在于将 fracton 的量子力学从格点模型推广到连续形式，并系统研究其少体问题。
papers.method_zh: 采用连续场论框架，通过施加对称性和局域性约束来构建 fracton 的量子力学，并分析其单体和少体行为。
keywords: electronic structure and strongly correlated systems

papers.title: Degenerate toroidal quasibound states in the continuum enabling polarization-independent exciton-polaritons
papers.abstract: Author(s): Xianyan Wei, Chaomian Wu, Yawei Chen, Jianhua Zeng, Weiyi Hong, and Fu Deng Achieving polarization-independent strong light-matter coupling remains a central challenge for practical integrated photonic platforms. Conventional metasurfaces based on bound states in the continuum (BICs) can sustain ultrahigh quality (Q) factors, yet their intrinsic polarization sensitivity lim…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：基于bound states in the continuum (BICs)的metasurfaces，偏振特性分析，光-物质强耦合）；研究对象：简并环形连续谱准束缚态（degenerate toroidal quasibound states in the continuum），以及基于该态实现的偏振无关激子-极化激元（polarization-independent exciton-polaritons）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过设计简并环形连续谱准束缚态，实现了偏振无关的强光-物质耦合，克服了传统BIC超表面固有的偏振敏感性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过设计简并环形连续谱准束缚态，实现了偏振无关的强光-物质耦合，克服了传统BIC超表面固有的偏振敏感性。；创新点：提出并实现了偏振无关的强光-物质耦合，解决了传统BIC超表面因偏振敏感而难以用于实际集成光子平台的瓶颈问题。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与设计，具体涉及连续谱束缚态（BIC）的简并化与环形模式构造，以及激子-极化激元耦合系统的建模。

papers.title: Anomalously robust Fabry-Pérot bound states in the continuum in a coupled triple-resonator system
papers.abstract: Author(s): Chao Song, Quansen Wang, Han Jia, Zhiwei Guo, Lujun Huang, and Yong Li Bound states in the continuum (BICs) with ultrahigh quality (Q) factors hold great promise for enhancing wave–matter interactions. However, their practical realization is hindered by extreme fragility to structural imperfections. Here, we report an anomalously robust Fabry–Pérot (FP) BIC in a couple…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章（可能包含数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要中未提及具体实验手段，主要讨论“bound states in the continuum (BICs)”的理论性质（如品质因子、鲁棒性），并描述了一个“coupled triple-resonator system”（耦合三谐振子系统）的模型。；研究对象：耦合三谐振子系统中的Fabry-Pérot（FP）连续谱束缚态（BIC）。具体物理现象是：在连续谱中实现具有超高Q值的束缚态，并研究其对结构缺陷的鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作报道了一种异常鲁棒的Fabry-Pérot连续谱束缚态（FP BIC），它克服了传统BIC对结构缺陷极度敏感（脆弱）的缺点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作报道了一种异常鲁棒的Fabry-Pérot连续谱束缚态（FP BIC），它克服了传统BIC对结构缺陷极度敏感（脆弱）的缺点。；创新点：发现了一种新型的、对结构缺陷具有异常鲁棒性的Fabry-Pérot BIC，这解决了传统BIC在实际应用中因对加工误差敏感而难以实现的瓶颈问题。摘要未突出说明其与已有鲁棒BIC方案的具体区别。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体计算方法或理论框架。从描述推断，可能采用了耦合模理论（Coupled Mode Theory, CMT）或基于麦克斯韦方程组的数值模拟（如有限元法FEM或时域有限差分法FDTD）来分析谐振器耦合系统中的模式特性与Q因子。

papers.title: Competitive orders in altermagnetic chiral magnons
papers.abstract: The magnons in altermagnets exhibit chiral splitting even in the absence of spin-orbit coupling and external magnetic fields. Typically, this chiral splitting behavior can be well described by alternating isotropic spin exchanges (ISEs) near the zero temperature. However, its finite-temperature dyna…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“描述”（described by）和“动力学”（dynamics），并讨论有限温度行为，属于理论建模范畴。；研究对象：交变磁体（altermagnet）中的手性磁振子（chiral magnons）。具体物理现象是交变磁体中手性磁振子的竞争序（competitive orders）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零温附近，交变磁体中的手性磁振子劈裂行为可由各向同性自旋交换（ISE）很好地描述；但在有限温度下，其动力学行为会发生变化，导致出现竞争序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零温附近，交变磁体中的手性磁振子劈裂行为可由各向同性自旋交换（ISE）很好地描述；但在有限温度下，其动力学行为会发生变化，导致出现竞争序。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断，该工作首次关注了交变磁体中手性磁振子在有限温度下的竞争序行为，而此前的研究通常集中于零温下的手性劈裂。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的理论框架或计算方法（如是否使用了线性自旋波理论、格林函数方法或蒙特卡洛模拟等），仅提及了“各向同性自旋交换”模型和“有限温度动力学”分析。

papers.title: Majorana zero modes and topological nature in the ${\mathrm{Bi}}_{2}{\mathrm{Ta}}_{3}{\mathrm{S}}_{6}$ family of superconductors
papers.abstract: In this work, we report that Bi2Ta3S6-family superconductors exhibit nontrivial band topology. They possess a natural quantum-well structure consisting of alternating stacks of TaS2 and honeycomb Bi layers, which contribute superconducting and topological properties, respectively. Symmetry-based ind…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（关键词：band topology, symmetry-based analysis）；研究对象：Bi₂Ta₃S₆家族超导体（具体为具有天然量子阱结构的层状材料）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Bi₂Ta₃S₆家族超导体具有非平庸的能带拓扑性质，其结构中的TaS₂层和蜂窝状Bi层分别贡献超导和拓扑特性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Bi₂Ta₃S₆家族超导体具有非平庸的能带拓扑性质，其结构中的TaS₂层和蜂窝状Bi层分别贡献超导和拓扑特性。；创新点：揭示了Bi₂Ta₃S₆家族材料中天然量子阱结构（TaS₂与Bi层交替堆叠）与超导及拓扑性质的关联，为在该体系中寻找马约拉纳零模提供了平台。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称性的能带拓扑分析（Symmetry-based analysis），具体方法摘要未明确说明（如是否使用DFT等）。

papers.title: Anharmonic superconducting density functional theory: A general framework for superconductivity with anharmonic corrections
papers.abstract: An First-principles studies of superconductivity often neglect anharmonic effects (AHE), despite their crucial role in achieving quantitative accuracy in many materials. To bridge this gap, we introduce a general computational approach, termed anharmonic superconducting density functional theory (ah-SC…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：First-principles studies（第一性原理研究）、computational approach（计算方法）、density functional theory（密度泛函理论）。；研究对象：超导体的量子现象，具体为超导态中的非简谐效应（anharmonic effects, AHE）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论，但指出非简谐效应对于实现超导研究的定量准确性至关重要，并提出了一个名为“非简谐超导密度泛函理论（ah-SCDFT）”的通用计算框架来弥补现有理论忽略该效应的不足。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论，但指出非简谐效应对于实现超导研究的定量准确性至关重要，并提出了一个名为“非简谐超导密度泛函理论（ah-SCDFT）”的通用计算框架来弥补现有理论忽略该效应的不足。；创新点：首次将非简谐效应系统地纳入超导密度泛函理论（SCDFT）的通用框架中，旨在解决第一性原理超导研究中长期忽略非简谐效应而导致的定量不准确问题。

papers.title: Quantitative thermodynamic study of superconducting and normal states in ${\mathrm{UTe}}_{2}$ under pressure
papers.abstract: Author(s): T. Vasina, M. Pfeiffer, R. Borth, M. Nicklas, M. Amano Patino, G. Lapertot, J.-P. Brison, E. Hassinger, G. Knebel, and D. Braithwaite Pressurized UTe2 exhibits a complex landscape of superconducting and magnetic phases. Here, the authors present a quantitative specific heat study under pressure that probes the increase of electronic correlations, through a threefold enhancement of the Sommerfeld coefficient with pressure, reveals some of the complex interactions between the different phases, and sheds new light on several puzzles of this unusual material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“quantitative specific heat study under pressure”（定量比热研究），属于实验手段。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是UTe₂（铀基超导体），重点研究其在压力下的超导态和正常态的热力学性质，以及伴随的压力诱导的电子关联增强和磁相竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过压力下的比热测量，发现Sommerfeld系数（电子比热系数）随压力增强约三倍，表明电子关联显著增强；同时揭示了不同超导相与磁相之间的复杂相互作用，为理解UTe₂的若干未解之谜提供了新视角。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过压力下的比热测量，发现Sommerfeld系数（电子比热系数）随压力增强约三倍，表明电子关联显著增强；同时揭示了不同超导相与磁相之间的复杂相互作用，为理解UTe₂的若干未解之谜提供了新视角。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用压力下的比热测量（specific heat measurement under pressure），通过定量分析Sommerfeld系数等热力学量来探测电子关联和相变行为。
keywords: electronic structure and strongly correlated systems

papers.abstract: We study the edge state properties of a two-dimensional kagome lattice using a tight-binding approach, focusing on the role of lattice termination, spin-orbit coupling, and magnetic order. In the pristine limit, we show that the existence of localized edge states is highly sensitive to boundary geom…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：关键词“tight-binding approach”（紧束缚方法）。；研究对象：二维kagome晶格中的边缘态。具体研究了晶格终止（边界几何）、自旋-轨道耦合和磁序对边缘态性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无缺陷的kagome晶格中，局域边缘态的存在与否高度依赖于边界几何构型（晶格终止方式）。
